jobs.excerpt: Recruiter (Talent Acquisition Specialist) Childcare Marketing | Remote-First | Full-Time Position OverviewWe are looking for a Recruiter who can identify exceptional talent, build strong candidate relationships, and help Childcare Marketing and our clients build high-performing teams.
jobs.description:
Recruiter (Talent Acquisition Specialist)

Childcare Marketing | Remote-First | Full-Time

Position Overview

We are looking for a Recruiter who can identify exceptional talent, build strong candidate relationships, and help Childcare Marketing and our clients build high-performing teams.

The Recruiter owns the full recruitment lifecycle - from sourcing and attracting candidates to conducting interviews, managing communication, and supporting successful hires. This role requires someone who understands that great recruiting is not about collecting resumes; it is about finding the right people who align with the opportunity, culture, and long-term goals.

You will partner closely with hiring managers to understand their needs, create effective sourcing strategies, and deliver a seamless hiring experience for both candidates and internal stakeholders.

Why You Should Work Here

  • Work That Matters: You transform lives by connecting families who need quality child care with the providers who serve them.
  • Recession-Proof Growth: An established, fast-growing company that continues to thrive while many competitors struggle.
  • Leadership That Has Your Back: A supportive, attentive team that answers your questions and helps you grow, professionally and personally.
  • An Owner Who Shows Up: Our owner is actively involved in the business - not just a name on the door.
  • Small-Team Feel: A friendly, tight-knit environment where you are a person, not a headcount.
  • Remote-First Flexibility: Work remotely while staying connected to a fast-moving, collaborative team. Buffalo-area candidates may also have opportunities for occasional in-person meetings, strategy sessions, or team gatherings.
  • Top-of-Market Pay: We pay above market because we hire the best and want to keep them.
  • Train to Be the Best: Access $100K+ in training, courses, and materials - enough to make you more knowledgeable than 99.9% of the account managers our competitors employ.
  • A Workspace That Feels Alive: Working from home can get lonely, so our virtual Sims-like office keeps the team connected day to day.
  • Quarterly Town Halls: Every quarter, you get a full state-of-the-company update, so you are never guessing where things stand.
  • The Dream-On Program: Each year, our CEO grants multiple wishes pulled straight from team members' dream boards.
  • 25 Days Off: A full 25 paid days off per year, because we want you to have a real life outside work.
  • Paid Days to Give Back: 4 paid days a year to volunteer with any charity you choose.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, you will develop a strong understanding of our hiring process, company culture, and the types of people who thrive at Childcare Marketing. You'll begin building robust talent pipelines, earning the trust of hiring managers, and taking ownership of recruiting outcomes. Ongoing, you will be measured on:

  • Hiring Success: Consistently identify, attract, and hire exceptional candidates who are aligned with both the role and our culture.
  • Quality of Hire: Present high-caliber candidates who are well-qualified, thoroughly evaluated, and ready to succeed—not just available to interview.
  • Time to Hire: Keep recruitment processes moving efficiently while maintaining an exceptional candidate experience and high hiring standards.
  • Talent Pipeline: Build and maintain proactive pipelines for key roles, reducing the time needed to fill future openings.
  • Candidate Experience: Deliver a professional, responsive, and engaging experience that reflects positively on Childcare Marketing from first contact through onboarding.
  • Hiring Manager Partnership: Become a trusted partner to hiring managers by communicating proactively, providing thoughtful recommendations, and helping them make confident hiring decisions.
  • Recruitment Process Excellence: Continuously improve our hiring process through better organization, documentation, reporting, and data-driven recommendations.
  • Employer Brand: Represent Childcare Marketing with professionalism and enthusiasm, helping us become an employer of choice for top talent.

A Typical Week Might Include

  • Partnering with hiring managers to understand current hiring priorities, define ideal candidates, and create effective recruitment strategies.
  • Sourcing and engaging qualified candidates through LinkedIn, Indeed, Monster, job boards, referrals, networking, and other talent channels.
  • Reviewing applications and identifying candidates who have the skills, experience, and mindset needed to succeed in the role.
  • Conducting structured screening interviews to evaluate qualifications, motivation, communication skills, and cultural alignment.
  • Managing candidate communication throughout the hiring process to ensure a professional and positive experience from first contact through the offer stage.
  • Coordinating interviews, collecting feedback, and keeping hiring processes moving efficiently.
  • Building and maintaining talent pipelines so we are prepared for future hiring needs—not just reacting to open positions.
  • Maintaining accurate candidate records, recruitment activity, and hiring updates within our ATS.
  • Reviewing recruitment metrics and identifying opportunities to improve sourcing strategies, candidate quality, and hiring efficiency.
  • Supporting employer branding initiatives that strengthen Childcare Marketing's reputation as a place where talented people want to work.

Key Competencies

  • Talent Sourcing & Recruitment Strategy: Ability to proactively identify, attract, and engage qualified candidates through multiple sourcing channels.
  • Candidate Assessment: Skilled at evaluating experience, skills, motivation, and cultural alignment to identify top talent.
  • Communication: Communicates clearly, professionally, and consistently with candidates, hiring managers, and internal teams.
  • Organization & Attention to Detail: Manages multiple open roles, candidate pipelines, deadlines, and recruitment activities without letting important details slip.
  • Ownership & Accountability: Takes responsibility for recruitment outcomes and proactively solves challenges throughout the hiring process.
  • Relationship Building: Builds trust with candidates and hiring managers through responsiveness, professionalism, and genuine engagement.

This Role Is Not for You If

  • You only prefer posting jobs and waiting for candidates instead of actively sourcing and building relationships.
  • You see recruiting as simply filling vacancies rather than finding the right person for the right opportunity.
  • You are uncomfortable conducting interviews or making recommendations based on candidate quality.
  • You need constant reminders to follow up, document next steps, or keep hiring processes moving.
  • You avoid difficult conversations with candidates or hiring managers.
  • You are not comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • You focus on the number of applicants rather than the quality of candidates presented.
  • You prefer administrative tasks over building relationships and influencing hiring outcomes.

Skills and Experience Required

  • 3–5 years of experience in recruiting, talent acquisition, or a similar role.
  • Proven experience managing the full recruitment lifecycle, from sourcing candidates through offer acceptance.
  • Strong sourcing, networking, and candidate engagement skills, with the ability to proactively identify and attract qualified talent.
  • Experience conducting structured interviews, screening candidates, and evaluating qualifications, skills, and cultural fit.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple open roles and priorities simultaneously.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with hiring managers and cross-functional teams.
  • Experience using applicant tracking systems (ATS) and recruitment platforms such as Jazz Recruiter, Indeed, Monster, LinkedIn, and other job boards or sourcing tools.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate candidate records, track recruitment activity, and manage candidate communication throughout the hiring process.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Previous experience recruiting for remote-first teams or distributed organizations.
  • Experience supporting multiple departments, hiring managers, or client accounts simultaneously.
  • Experience recruiting within a digital marketing agency, creative agency, technology company, SaaS business, or other fast-paced professional services environment.
  • Experience hiring for marketing, creative, sales, customer success, operations, or other client-facing roles.
  • Experience building proactive talent pipelines rather than relying solely on inbound applicants.
  • Experience tracking recruitment metrics such as source effectiveness, time-to-fill, candidate quality, interview conversion rates, and hiring outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to improve recruiting processes, strengthen candidate experience, and introduce more efficient ways of attracting top talent.
  • Experience working in an agency environment where speed, adaptability, communication, and delivering results are critical.

Work Environment

This is a full-time, remote-first position.

About Childcare Marketing Group

Childcare Marketing Group helps child care centers, day nurseries, and early education businesses attract more families, retain enrollment, and grow with smarter marketing. We are a fast-growing, remote-first marketing company serving clients across the U.S., U.K., and beyond.

jobs.title: YouTube Script Writer
jobs.excerpt: RoleCreate YouTube content that transforms healthcare expertise into videos patients actually choose to watch.
jobs.description:
Role

Create YouTube content that transforms healthcare expertise into videos patients actually choose to watch.

You'll work directly with doctors, surgeons, dentists and other health experts to uncover what makes them different, identify the questions their patients are actually asking, and turn decades of expertise into compelling YouTube content that educates, builds trust and grows their practice.

This isn't blogging, SEO writing or simply turning articles into video scripts. It's equal parts content strategy, audience psychology, packaging and storytelling.

Before writing a script, you'll identify the strongest topics, develop titles and thumbnail concepts that earn attention, and ensure every video serves a clear strategic purpose within the client's channel.

We need someone who writes for the ear, not the eye. Every sentence should make the next sentence impossible not to hear.

Results

1. Clients become known for something

Every client develops a clear positioning strategy and focused content ecosystem rather than publishing random health tips.

2. Every script earns attention

Scripts consistently create curiosity, tension and retention while remaining medically accurate.

3. Clients sound like themselves

Every script feels authentic to the doctor's voice rather than sounding like it came from ChatGPT or a generic copywriter.

4. Videos support channel strategy

Every video strengthens the broader content plan, builds topical authority and serves a strategic purpose.

5. Clients feel confident on camera

Clients understand why each topic exists and feel excited to record it.

Responsibilities

Content Strategy

  • Identify high leverage content opportunities
  • Develop channel positioning
  • Build playlist strategies
  • Identify audience awareness levels
  • Prioritize topics that support business goals
  • Help clients niche down where appropriate
  • Recommend content sequencing

Packaging

Develop titles, hooks and thumbnail copy before writing.

Think through:

  • Why would someone click?
  • What question are they trying to answer?
  • What tension exists?
  • What assumption are we challenging?
  • What curiosity gap are we creating?
  • What promise are we making?

Script Writing

Write 7 to 12 minute YouTube outlines & scripts that:

  • Hook immediately
  • Maintain curiosity with open loops
  • Explain complex medical topics simply
  • Apply direct-response thinking to educational content, structuring ideas for momentum, comprehension, and action
  • Sound conversational
  • Feel natural when spoken
  • Avoid unnecessary jargon
  • Keep viewers watching

Research

Research:

  • Medical literature
  • Competing videos
  • Patient language
  • Market awareness
  • Common objections
  • Search intent
  • Healthcare trends

…while remaining grounded in evidence.

Client Collaboration

Lead strategy conversations with clients.

Interview them.

Challenge assumptions.

Extract stories.

Refine positioning.

Gain buy in around channel direction.

Coach clients toward stronger content decisions.

Continuous Improvement

Review video performance.

Identify patterns.

Refine future topics.

Improve packaging.

Improve retention.

Improve scripts based on viewer behavior.

This is not a role for someone who simply writes scripts. It's a role for someone who can identify what is genuinely interesting, package it in a way that earns attention, and then write a script that keeps viewers watching.

Requirements

Must Have:

Strong Healthcare Background

You have significant experience working in, writing about or communicating complex health topics.

You understand medical terminology, conventional and natural health perspectives, patient concerns and the importance of accurate, evidence-based communication.

Relevant backgrounds may include:

  • Healthcare marketing
  • Medical or scientific writing
  • Experience as a clinician or health practitioner
  • Patient education
  • Ghostwriting for health experts
  • Medical communications
  • Healthcare journalism
  • Experience interviewing subject matter experts
  • Experience working with physicians, practices or healthcare brands

Exceptional Conversational Writing

You naturally write the way people speak.

Your scripts sound effortless when read aloud and can be adapted to reflect different clients' personalities and speaking styles.

You understand that a technically correct sentence can still sound unnatural when spoken.

Strategic and Editorial Judgment

You do not simply complete the assigned topic.

You ask:

  • Should we make this video?
  • Is this genuinely interesting?
  • Is the angle strong enough?
  • Is the topic meaningfully different from what we have already published?
  • Is the information useful or merely obvious?
  • Does this idea support the client's broader positioning?

You can identify the strongest idea, remove what does not belong and build the video around one clear promise.

Audience and Packaging Instincts

You understand the difference between the topic, the intended viewer and the packaging used to attract that viewer.

You can identify:

  • Who the video is for
  • Their level of awareness
  • What they already understand
  • What they are worried about
  • What they are curious about
  • What would make them click
  • What promise the video must fulfill

You ensure that the title, thumbnail, opening hook and actual content remain aligned.

Retention and Storytelling Instincts

You understand how to unfold information rather than dump it all at once.

You can use:

  • Curiosity gaps
  • Open loops
  • Escalating stakes
  • Pacing
  • Tension
  • Pattern interruptions
  • Delayed reveals
  • Payoffs

You know when to answer a question and when to hold the answer long enough to keep the viewer engaged without becoming manipulative or frustrating.

Ability to Simplify Complexity

You can quickly understand complicated subjects, identify what matters most to the intended viewer and explain it in clear, conversational language without oversimplifying or introducing inaccuracies.

Research and Interviewing Skills

You are comfortable entering unfamiliar areas of health, researching them responsibly and asking experts detailed questions until you truly understand their perspective.

You know the difference between gathering information and uncovering what is actually interesting.

AI Fluency and Editorial Control

You use AI to accelerate research, ideation, organization and early drafts without outsourcing your judgment to it.

You know how to direct, challenge and refine AI-generated work.

Every final script must feel original, specific, conversational and human.

You are able to identify and remove common signs of weak AI-generated writing, including:

  • Repetition
  • Generic phrasing
  • Unnecessary summaries
  • False drama
  • Awkward transitions
  • Overexplaining
  • Bloated lists
  • Predictable sentence patterns
  • Confusing or imprecise word choices
  • Information that sounds important but says very little

AI may support the process. It cannot replace thinking.

Ruthless Editing

You understand that strong writing is often created by removing more than you add.

You instinctively eliminate:

  • Repetition
  • Obvious statements
  • Weak examples
  • Unnecessary context
  • Jargon
  • Filler
  • Tangents
  • Anything that does not advance the argument, deepen the viewer's understanding or create interest in what comes next

Client-Facing Communication

You are comfortable leading conversations with accomplished health professionals.

You can listen carefully, ask challenging questions, explain strategic decisions, respond professionally to feedback and respectfully push back when a client's preferred direction is unlikely to work.

You build confidence without becoming passive or overly agreeable.

Relevant Backgrounds and Preferred Experience

YouTube

  • Deep understanding of YouTube as a platform, including packaging, viewer psychology, retention, audience expectations and what earns attention in educational content.
  • Experience developing YouTube content strategies, playlists, titles and thumbnail concepts.
  • Experience reviewing channel analytics and using performance data to improve future content.

Direct Response & Marketing

  • Understands direct response principles and knows how to apply them to YouTube without making videos feel like advertisements.
  • Experience with direct response copywriting, funnels or VSLs.

Storytelling & Content

  • Journalism
  • Documentary writing
  • Podcast production
  • Educational content
  • Content marketing
  • Behavioral psychology

What Great Looks Like

A great Content Strategist and YouTube Script Writer:

  • Thinks like a strategist before thinking like a writer.
  • Identifies what patients want to know before writing what the expert wants to say.
  • Knows the difference between technically informative and genuinely interesting.
  • Creates curiosity without relying on misleading clickbait.
  • The secret code is HP2026
  • Treats the topic, title, thumbnail, hook and script as one connected idea.
  • Writes specifically for the viewer's level of awareness.
  • Builds and unfolds ideas rather than giving away the entire answer immediately.
  • Makes complex health concepts clear without making them inaccurate.
  • Helps clients discover and strengthen their positioning.
  • Pushes back when a topic, angle or explanation is unlikely to perform.
  • Writes for spoken delivery rather than written prose.
  • Uses AI intelligently but never passes off unedited AI output as completed work.
  • Balances scientific credibility, client voice and viewer retention.
  • Learns from analytics and becomes more effective over time.
Salary: $6,000-$7,500/mo

jobs.description:
About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

Please fill out our application form to apply for UX Woman sponsoring your participation in the program. The application takes 5 minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your LinkedIn profile and resume, as well as ask you about why you are interested in this program. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.
You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status.If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

We’re not just expanding connectivity; we’re reimagining what a connected nation looks like. With £11bn invested in 5G and digital infrastructure, your work will directly power businesses, services, and communities across the country.

You’ll work on real challenges, with real impact, across every corner of the country. Wherever you join us, whatever your role, you’ll be helping to build a future that works better for everyone.

We move at pace, because what we’re building matters – and we’re learning as we go. We’re proud of the progress we’ve made, but we’re just getting started.

Join our UK Networks team, where we’re continually building and enhancing our network, connecting millions of people and businesses across the country. Be part of the team that makes it all happen – simplifying, automating, and bringing better connectivity than ever before, with giga-fast speed, to our customers.

What you’ll do

The Proactive Principal Specialist leads the technical delivery of proactive broadband solutions using Zhilabs, combining coding, data analysis, and automation to identify and resolve issues before they impact customers. It drives measurable improvements in customer experience, operational efficiency, and commercial value through predictive modelling and cross-functional collaboration.

  • You will design and deliver proactive broadband use cases using Zhilabs to detect service issues early and improve customer experience.
  • You will develop and maintain clean, efficient code and scripts (e.g., Python, SQL) to support proactive user stories and automation.
  • You will build and optimise dashboards that visualise network and customer metrics, enabling fast and confident decision-making.
  • You will lead technical delivery of proactive initiatives from concept through backlog shaping, testing, and go-live readiness.
  • You will apply predictive modelling techniques to forecast service degradation and prevent customer impact.
  • You will implement workflow automations that reduce manual effort and support scalable, end-to-end delivery.
  • You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to validate use cases via A/B testing and ensure alignment with customer and business outcomes.
  • You will host regular interlock sessions to review defects, share insights, and identify new proactive opportunities.

Who you are

  • You will be proficient in Python and SQL; experience with APIs and automation tools.
  • You will have strong data analysis skills and experience with large datasets.
  • You will be skilled in dashboard creation using Power BI or Tableau.
  • You will be familiar with broadband service issues and repair processes.
  • You will have agile working experience and strong communication skills.
  • You will have the ability to translate technical insights into business outcomes.
  • You will have a strong background in service operations, technical delivery, or proactive service enablement.
  • You will have experience leading automation and data driven fault prevention initiatives, including the use of A/B testing to validate improvements.
  • You will have extensive experience and deep knowledge in Fixed and Mobile Network Design, Capacity and Performance management.
  • You will have experience in brand friendly communication through sms, email, voice campaigns
  • You will have experience of building relationships across teams and partners
  • You will have experience in CPE configuration and management using TR69 and other protocols


Worried that you don’t meet all the desired criteria exactly?
We know that everyone is unique, with multiple aspects to their identity and different experiences behind them. We are passionate about Inclusion for All and creating a workplace where everyone can thrive, whatever their personal or professional background. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align exactly with every part of the job description, we encourage you to apply as you may be the right candidate for this role or another role, and our recruitment team can help you see how your skills fit in.

What we offer

We care about our people’s success by offering great pay, bonuses, up to 28 days off plus bank holidays, and paid time for charity work. You can personalise our benefits for you and your family, like discounts, vouchers, a pension plan and loads more. We help with your career through our amazing learning tools and top-notch parental leave policies.



Need to Know

We are regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority and all offers of employment for this role are subject to background checks, including criminal (DBS) and financial checks to meet the regulators standards.

If you require any reasonable adjustments or have an accessibility request as part of your recruitment journey, for example, extended time or breaks in between online assessments, a sign language interpreter, or assistive technology, please refer to the Accessibility section of our Careers website () for guidance.

We use AI in different parts of our business to boost innovation, improve efficiency, and create new opportunities. We know many candidates use AI to fine-tune their CVs or prepare for interviews, but what we really care about is your unique experiences and achievements.

During the interview, we want you to rely on your own knowledge and skills to show us who you really are—your personality, creativity, and abilities. Above all, we’re looking for authenticity and can’t wait to get to know the real you.

jobs.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

This position is open only to candidates currently based in and legally authorized to work in one of the following EMEA locations: South Africa, Serbia or Romania. Fully home-based working is available in all three locations.

Picture Yourself At Parexel:

The Data Surveillance Analyst (DSA) is responsible for analyzing scientific and operational data to support the Data Surveillance process and reviewing project-specific Quality Tolerance Limits. They assist in developing Data Surveillance Plans (DSPs) and conduct defined project reviews. The DSA also attends internal and external Data Surveillance meetings, where they present relevant findings to the project team.

What You'll Do At Parexel:

Data Surveillance Plan Development and Technology Configuration:

  • Support the development of a robust Data Surveillance Plan, including Key Risk Indicators, Quality Tolerance Limits, and central statistical analysis.

  • Configure and Maintain Data Surveillance technologies (e.g., CluePoints Central Monitoring Platform):

- Create data import mapping for all data sources

- Create and set-up standard and bespoke KRIs.

- Create and set-up statistical analysis parameters.

Data Surveillance Review:

  • Review relevant data via the scoped technologies and additional sources as required to support reviews designated for the DS Analyst per the project specific Data Surveillance Plan, including project specific Quality Tolerance Limits.

  • Document findings from Data Surveillance activities in the DS Findings Form, Issue Tracking system(s) and other as appropriate.

  • Provide feedback and work with Technology teams to identify potential solutions that match the business and technology strategy.

  • Apply working knowledge and judgment to identify and evaluate potential data quality trend, outliers and emergent issues. Determine and implement appropriate follow-up action with the input of other / relevant parties and / or guidance provided, if applicable.

  • Actively participate in Investigator and other external or internal meetings and audits & regulatory inspections as required.

  • Recognize impact of study non-compliance/issues/delays/data quality signals and communicate/ promptly escalate to FL any site and/or study issues that require immediate action.

  • Perform core reviews per DS Plan.

  • Document instances of atypical data per DS Plan.

  • Collaborate with DS Team Members to correlate findings from various sources.

  • Support Project Leads with DS Review meeting, driving reviews and decisions as needed and agreeing on actions.

  • Engage DS Team to compile signals/actions into client ready list.

  • Support documentation of actions in CluePoints Issue Management system (links to IH for any on-site interventions required).

  • Complete, share, and file Central Monitoring Report.

Here are a few requirements specific to this advertised role:

  • University degree (medical, biological science, pharmacy, and/or data analytics).

  • Fluent English.

  • Basic SAS programing experience required.

  • Experience with Risk-Based Quality Management (RBQM) processes and data surveillance methods.

  • Familiarity with centralized monitoring and Data Driven Monitoring practices.

  • Proficient in data analysis, trend identification, and issue triage.

  • Proficient in relevant software: CTMS, EDMS, MS Office.

  • Basic understanding of SDTM domains and data operations concepts.

  • Experience with CluePoints would be a strong asset.

  • Client-focused with strong quality orientation.

  • Effective in matrix and global virtual team environments.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, including presentation abilities.

  • Strong time management and multitasking capabilities.

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Why join us:

Be part of groundbreaking projects that are pushing the boundaries of the industry. Experience a collaborative and inclusive work environment that highly appreciates your expertise. Unlock your full potential with professional growth and development opportunities. Enjoy work life balance and flexible working hours.

If this job does not sound like the next step in your career, but you know of someone who would be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Paid Media and Creative Specialist

Compensation range: $2,000 AUD - $2,800 AUD / Monthly

Engagement type:Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: This role is designed to support the North American commercial business and AU business hours for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: Born from a passion for adventure and a relentless pursuit of comfort, we create premium performance apparel designed to help people get more out of every outdoor experience. By combining natural fibers with technical innovation, our products deliver exceptional softness, breathability, moisture management, and temperature regulation in all conditions. Whether exploring alpine environments, tackling rugged trails, or embracing everyday adventures, our focus is simple: designing high-performance gear that feels better, lasts longer, and allows you to move with confidence wherever your journey takes you.

Role Overview: Paid Media & Creative Performance Specialist to develop our seasonal performance strategy and execute the tactical initiatives required to deliver against clearly defined commercial targets, for our premium merino wool outdoor apparel brand across Australia and North America (US & Canada). There's also a chance the role will extend to our Europe accounts down the track, though that's not yet confirmed.

You'll take creative assets from our content team — photography, video, campaign collateral — and turn them into strong, well-optimised ads across Meta and Google. Alongside ROAS, we'd like campaigns optimised against MER (Marketing Efficiency Ratio) so we get a clear read on overall marketing efficiency rather than platform-reported numbers alone.

You'll work day-to-day with our eCommerce and Marketing Manager to keep paid media aligned with inventory, seasonal campaigns, product launches and key moments of the company’s calendar — across both AU and North America.

Key Responsibilities:

PAID MEDIA MANAGEMENT

  • Manage and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Meta, Google and other relevant channels across AU and North America.
  • Optimise campaigns against both ROAS and MER (Marketing Efficiency Ratio), keeping an eye on overall marketing efficiency rather than platform metrics alone.
  • Own the paid media budget end-to-end — allocating spend across regions and channels, using profitability signals such as margin and inventory position to guide decisions, and defending those decisions with data.
  • Own the full-funnel paid architecture — from prospecting through to retargeting — rather than just executing individual campaigns.
  • Identify opportunities to scale winning campaigns while reducing acquisition costs, and build a strong retargeting strategy that grows customer lifetime value.
  • Keep a proactive eye on competitor activity and market trends, feeding that intelligence back into strategy rather than only optimising what's already live.
  • Stay ahead of platform updates and emerging paid media best practice, including AI-driven optimisation tools (e.g. Meta Advantage+/AI), and continually test new approaches to improve performance.

CREATIVE PERFORMANCE, STRATEGY & ASSET SUPPORT

  • Take creative assets (photography, video, campaign collateral) from our content and design team and turn them into the best-performing ads across Meta and Google.
  • Analyse ad creative performance to identify winning hooks, messaging, offers and formats, and feed those insights back into the creative process.
  • Prepare clear, actionable creative briefs for designers, videographers and UGC creators based on performance data and upcoming campaign needs.
  • Hands-on graphic design capability is highly valued — able to adapt, resize, and refresh creative assets (static and light video edits) for different placements and tests without always relying on the design team.
  • Build a repeatable creative testing framework that drives ongoing performance improvement across all markets.

CAMPAIGN & SEASONAL ALIGNMENT

  • Work day-to-day with the Marketing & eCommerce Manager team to align paid media with inventory levels, website changes, product launches and key strategic moments through the season.
  • Build season-specific strategies for each region — recognising that AU and North America hit their peak and quiet periods at opposite times of year, and adjusting spend and targeting accordingly.
  • Support major sales events, promotional periods and new product launches with campaigns planned ahead of key dates.

CUSTOMER SEGMENTATION, RETARGETING

  • Build distinct paid and retargeting strategies for new customers versus repeat/existing customers, recognising that acquisition and retention require different messaging, offers and channels.
  • Design retargeting strategies that build customer lifetime value, not just short-term conversion.
  • Work within Klaviyo to help segment our customer base and build flows targeting specific groups such as past/lapsed spenders, VIPs and high-LTV customers, in coordination with paid media activity.
  • Use segmentation and first-party data to inform audience strategy across Meta and Google.

REPORTING & ANALYSIS

  • Produce fortnightly reporting on campaign performance, covering ROAS, MER, CAC, CPA, CTR, CPC and conversion rate.
  • Identify audience segments, customer behaviours and purchasing trends across AU and North America.
  • Monitor attribution and conversion data using GA4 and other analytics platforms.
  • Provide clear, actionable recommendations — not just data — to improve overall marketing performance.

ECOMMERCE GROWTH & CONVERSION OPTIMISATION

  • Work closely with the eCommerce Manager to improve conversion rates across landing pages and product campaigns.
  • Support new product launches, seasonal campaigns and promotional activity with a joined-up view of site, inventory and paid media.
  • Contribute ideas that improve the customer journey from first click through to purchase and beyond.

Requirements

  • 5+ years' experience managing paid advertising campaigns for eCommerce or consumer brands, including experience across both Australian and North American (US & Canada) markets. Europe experience is a bonus but not required.
  • Strong experience with Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads, including Meta's AI/Advantage+ optimisation tools.
  • Working knowledge of Klaviyo, including audience segmentation and flow building.
  • Experience with Shopify and Google Analytics 4 (GA4).
  • Understanding of Marketing Efficiency Ratio (MER), alongside standard ROAS/CPA metrics.
  • Graphic design skills (e.g. Canva, Photoshop, or similar) and comfort adapting creative assets for paid social.
  • Experience analysing creative performance and translating it into clear creative recommendations and briefs.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Highly Regarded

  • UGC creator management experience.
  • Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO) experience.
  • Confident use of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or MetaAI in day-to-day workflow.
  • Experience with fashion, lifestyle, sporting goods or outdoor retail brands.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

Our backend is powered by Node.js (Koa, NestJS) and MongoDB. The frontend stack includes Webpack, Vue.js, and React, with nearly all code written in TypeScript. For high-throughput messaging and background processing, we use Kafka (for millions of events) and Bull (Redis). Analytics data is stored in ClickHouse, and we use Elasticsearch for search.

The Team

We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals, including 80+ engineers. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus. Tap to Donate lets a staff member or volunteer accept contactless payments directly on a smartphone. Giving Station is a self-service donation point: a donor selects an amount on a tablet and pays through a connected external payment terminal.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

The Office of Information Services (OIS) is a shared service provider for the Oregon Health Authority (OHA) and Oregon Department of Human Services (ODHS). OIS provides the technology systems and services that support more than 18,000 OHA and ODHS agency staff at local offices and facilities around Oregon. These systems and services help the two agencies determine client service program eligibility; provide medical, housing, food, and job assistance; provide addiction, mental health, vocational and rehabilitative services; protect children, seniors and people with physical and/or developmental disabilities; process claims and benefits; manage provider licensing and Oregon hospital facilities; and promote and protect the Oregon public health.
Senate Bill (SB) 972 requires OHA to transition the Oregon Health Insurance Marketplace (OHIM) from a state-based marketplace using the federal platform (SBM-FP) to a state-based marketplace (SBM) using its own technology in time for open enrollment for plan year 2027. Specifically, OHA is required to procure and administer an information technology platform or service and call center, separate from the federal platform and call center, to provide electronic access to the health insurance marketplace in this state by November 1, 2026.
Scope of Work:
The Oregon Health Authority OHIM seeks an experienced UAT Business Subject Matter Expert Tester to support the SB 972 Transition Project as Oregon moves from an SBM FP to a full State Based Marketplace (SBM). Contractor’s Key Person shall work closely with Marketplace business partners, GetInsured, Medicaid/ONE system teams, and technical teams to ensure the new marketplace platform meets business needs, supports compliance, and delivers accurate, highquality functionality.
Contractor’s Key person shall provide advanced user acceptance testing support for the development and implementation of Oregon’s new StateBased Marketplace (SBM). Contractor’s Key Person shall ensure that eligibility, enrollment, and Marketplace operations systems meet business needs, align with policy, and function correctly for consumers, partners, and programs.
Contractor’s Key Person shall collaborate closely with Marketplace business partners, product staff, technical teams, the Oregon Health Insurance Marketplace’s vendor GetInsured, and Oregon’s Medicaid division—specifically the teams supporting the ONE eligibility system to design, execute, and validate UAT activities in both agile and traditional delivery environments. Contractor’s Key Person shall serve as a subject matter expert in test design, test execution, defect analysis, and continuous improvement of testing processes.

  • Contribute to or support load, performance, security, and accessibility testing.
  • Prepare, request, or curate test data required for UAT cycles.
  • Validate UAT readiness including requirements, environments, tools, and data availability.
  • Participate in defect triage, contributing to assessments of priority, severity, and business impact.
  • Provide guidance, coaching, and support to business SMEs participating in UAT.
  • Develop and maintain UAT best practices, documentation, templates, and training materials.
  • Provide daily/weekly test metrics, summaries, and progress updates to program leadership.
  • Fully participate in Scrum ceremonies (If applicable) including planning, refinement, standups, demos, and retrospectives.
  • Contribute to release readiness assessments and go/nogo recommendations.

  • Serve as a Business SME Tester responsible for validating system behavior from an endtoend business perspective.

Required Skills and Experience:

jobs.excerpt: Tenancy ManagerRole OverviewWe are seeking an experienced and highly organised Tenancy Manager to manage all aspects of tenancy administration and ongoing tenancy management across a residential property portfolio.
jobs.description:
Tenancy Manager

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly organised Tenancy Manager to manage all aspects of tenancy administration and ongoing tenancy management across a residential property portfolio.

The successful candidate will act as the main liaison between landlords, tenants, contractors and internal colleagues. They will be responsible for ensuring that tenancy matters are handled accurately, professionally and in accordance with relevant legislation and company procedures.

This role requires strong property-management knowledge, excellent communication skills and the ability to manage a busy workload with minimal errors or complaints.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Tenancy Management

  • Respond to landlord and tenant enquiries promptly and professionally.
  • Act as the main point of contact for matters relating to active tenancies.
  • Arrange and administer tenancy terminations.
  • Process notices received from tenants.
  • Manage early termination requests.
  • Arrange property check-outs.
  • Handle deposit negotiations and deposit returns.
  • Prepare and submit deposit disputes where required.
  • Manage tenancy-related and neighbour disputes.
  • Cancel rent guarantee policies when necessary.
  • Ensure all daily diary actions are completed without unnecessary carry-over.
  • Maintain complete and accurate records of every action and communication, including attempted contact.
  • Communicate updates and messages clearly to colleagues through the company’s property-management system.

Rent and Arrears Management

  • Monitor rent accounts and identify arrears promptly.
  • Contact tenants to collect outstanding payments.
  • Notify landlords of rent arrears and provide regular updates.
  • Submit Universal Credit documentation, including UC47 claims, where applicable.
  • Maintain accurate records of payment arrangements and arrears activity.
  • Escalate unresolved arrears in accordance with company procedures.

Maintenance and Repairs

  • Receive, assess and action maintenance reports within agreed company timescales.
  • Determine the urgency, risk and potential danger associated with reported repairs.
  • Provide tenants and landlords with appropriate advice regarding their obligations.
  • Appoint suitably qualified and registered contractors.
  • Obtain quotations and landlord approval where costs exceed the authorised spending limit.
  • Ensure contractors respond promptly and complete work within agreed timescales.
  • Follow up on every maintenance job until satisfactory completion.
  • Obtain photographic evidence of completed work where possible.
  • Collect contractor invoices and add them to the relevant landlord ledger for payment.
  • Deal with local authority schedules of work and improvement notices.
  • Identify whether works are regulated or require formal reporting.
  • Maintain clear communication with landlords throughout the maintenance process.

Compliance

  • Run weekly property safety and compliance reports.
  • Monitor expiry dates and renewal requirements for:
    • Gas safety certificates
    • Electrical safety certificates
    • Energy Performance Certificates
    • Fire safety documentation
    • Emergency lighting inspections
    • Portable Appliance Testing
    • Property licences
    • Visa or right-to-rent expiry dates
    • Chimney sweep certificates
  • Chase outstanding safety certificates and compliance documents.
  • Ensure that property licensing remains current and appropriate.
  • Manage failed Electrical Installation Condition Reports and arrange required remedial works.
  • Escalate serious compliance risks immediately.
  • Maintain accurate audit trails and supporting documentation.

Client and Customer Care

  • Provide positive, professional and proactive communication at all times.
  • Keep landlords informed of tenancy, maintenance, compliance and arrears matters.
  • Report anomalies or risks and take appropriate action to resolve them.
  • Manage expectations clearly and provide timely progress updates.
  • Handle complaints sensitively and work to achieve satisfactory outcomes.
  • Help retain landlords by delivering an accurate and dependable service.
  • Represent the company professionally in every interaction.

Candidate Requirements

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Previous experience in tenancy management, property management or residential lettings.
  • A strong understanding of tenancy agreements and the obligations of landlords and tenants.
  • Experience managing maintenance, arrears, deposits, compliance and tenancy terminations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • The ability to manage a high-volume workload and competing priorities.
  • A customer-focused and solutions-driven approach.
  • The confidence to handle difficult conversations and disputes.
  • Strong organisational and record-keeping skills.
  • The ability to work independently and take ownership of cases.
  • Experience using property-management or CRM systems.
  • ARLA or equivalent property qualification would be advantageous.

Required Knowledge

Candidates should have a practical understanding of:

  • Residential tenancy agreements
  • Deposit protection and dispute processes
  • Rent arrears procedures
  • Universal Credit and the benefits system
  • Houses in Multiple Occupation compliance
  • Property licensing requirements
  • Landlord repairing obligations
  • Section 11 of the Landlord and Tenant Act 1985
  • The Homes (Fitness for Human Habitation) Act
  • The Housing Health and Safety Rating System
  • LACORS fire-safety guidance
  • Gas, electrical, fire and general property-safety compliance

Key Performance Measures

Performance in the role will be assessed against:

  • Landlord and client satisfaction
  • Portfolio retention
  • Rent arrears levels
  • Deposit-return timescales
  • Successful resolution of overpayments
  • Number of completed maintenance jobs
  • Maintenance completion timescales
  • Outstanding safety certificates
  • Compliance accuracy
  • Quality and completeness of system records
  • Timely completion of diary actions
  • Resolution of tenancy and customer-service issues

Job Title: Associate Director, Value Assessment - Vaccines- US WEST- (REMOTE)

US healthcare is moving towards value-based payments and risk-based arrangements between payers and providers. The payment of our risk-bearing (RBO) customers is tied to cost-effective care.

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

  • Proactively partner with Account Management, Pricing & Contracting, Marketing and MSL to align and best address customers’ needs

  • Develop training to educate internal stakeholders

Implement health economic and outcomes research to large, organized customers as part of the proactive customer-centric approach and create opportunities to differentiate Sanofi Vaccines

  • Identify and satisfy customers’ reimbursement and risk-bearing contracts needs

  • Adapt existing tools to a more health system focus

  • Proactive approach to detail holistic Sanofi Vaccines offering

  • Collaborate with Account Managers to identify customers` expectations

About You

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree required

  • Traveling up to 50% of time

  • 5+ years of experience in market access, payer engagement, or health economics related function (Vaccines a plus)

  • Demonstrated experience in account management and health system navigation

  • Maintain compliance with all applicable Sanofi policies and procedures, regulatory and legal requirements, and help to monitor compliance during cross functional team interactions

  • Vast understanding of commercial payer reimbursement and risk-barring methodology

  • Financial experience, vaccines understanding - Strong understanding of financial analysis/economic modeling

  • Develop and interpret content in keeping with client requests and needs in compliance with Sanofi guidelines

  • Attention to building and maintaining customer relationships to achieve success

  • Continually focuses on the performance and development of oneself and others to enhance the talent of the company

  • Exhibits strong analytical skills and decision-making expertise

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

jobs.excerpt: Req ID:384999 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us.
jobs.description:
Req ID:384999

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a SAP S/4HANA Finance Solution Architect / FICO Lead - Remote US Position

SAP S/4HANA Finance Solution Architect / FICO Practice Lead

Senior Solution Architecture Role | Primary Skill: Finance | Secondary Skill: Controlling

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance Solution Architect to serve as the senior subject matter expert and central solution authority for SAP Finance within NTT DATA. This role requires deep expertise in Financial Accounting, supported by strong working knowledge of Controlling, and will provide leadership across assessments, advisory engagements, implementations, conversions, and optimization programs.

The architect will work directly with CFOs, controllers, finance leaders, business process owners, enterprise architects, and SAP delivery teams. The individual will help clients understand finance processes and SAP capabilities, analyze complex requirements and pain points, answer solution questions, evaluate options, and define scalable SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions aligned with standard functionality and clean-core principles.

This is a client-facing and practice leadership role for a hands-on architect who can operate across business process advisory, solution design, delivery governance, presales support, and issue resolution. Manufacturing industry experience is required, together with experience in one or more additional industries.

Key Responsibilities

SAP Finance Solution Leadership

  • Serve as the senior SAP Finance SME across SAP S/4HANA transformation, assessment, implementation, and advisory engagements.
  • Own the Finance solution strategy and architecture across Greenfield, Brownfield, and Selective Data Transition programs.
  • Lead end-to-end solution design for Record-to-Report, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Financial Close, Intercompany Accounting, and Financial Reporting.
  • Provide architecture-level oversight for Controlling and management accounting, ensuring full integration with the Finance solution.
  • Act as the primary escalation point for complex Finance design, integration, data, reporting, and delivery issues.
  • Establish reusable Finance architecture principles, design standards, and leading practices across client engagements.

Finance Solution Design and Architecture

  • Lead solution architecture and detailed design for core SAP S/4HANA Finance capabilities, including:
    • General Ledger, Universal Journal, parallel ledgers, currencies, and document splitting
    • Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Business Partner, and payment processing
    • Asset Accounting, bank accounting, tax, foreign currency valuation, and intercompany accounting
    • Financial close, statutory and management reporting, embedded analytics, and SAP Fiori for Finance
    • Credit, collections, dispute management, cash management, and Treasury integration
  • Translate business, accounting, regulatory, and operational requirements into scalable SAP solutions.
  • Evaluate solution alternatives, articulate trade-offs, and provide clear recommendations to business and project leadership.
  • Ensure alignment with SAP standard capabilities, S/4HANA simplifications, clean-core principles, and future-state enterprise architecture.
  • Review and approve functional designs, configurations, reports, workflows, interfaces, conversion designs, and integration specifications.

Client Advisory and Finance Transformation

  • Engage with CFOs, controllers, finance directors, process owners, and business users to understand current processes, business challenges, controls, and strategic priorities.
  • Lead finance assessments, discovery sessions, Fit-to-Standard workshops, and future-state process design sessions.
  • Help clients understand SAP S/4HANA Finance capabilities and explain complex solution concepts in clear business language.
  • Analyze current-state processes and identify opportunities for simplification, standardization, automation, stronger controls, and improved reporting.
  • Develop finance transformation roadmaps, solution options, implementation strategies, business cases, and executive recommendations.
  • Advise on finance operating models, shared services, close optimization, governance, chart of accounts harmonization, and organizational design.

S/4HANA Transformation and Delivery

  • Assess the impact of S/4HANA simplifications on finance processes, configuration, reports, interfaces, controls, and custom developments.
  • Guide decisions related to ledger and currency strategy, parallel accounting, document splitting, Business Partner, New Asset Accounting, and financial reporting.
  • Lead or advise on Finance data migration for balances, open items, assets, bank and tax data, cost objects, and historical data.
  • Assess RICEFW requirements and challenge unnecessary customization to support a clean-core solution.
  • Provide solution oversight through design, build, testing, cutover, go-live, and hypercare.
  • Support test strategy, defect resolution, mock conversions, financial reconciliation, cutover planning, and go-live readiness.

Integration and Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Coordinate closely with MM, SD, PP, QM, EWM, PM, PS, HCM, Treasury, Group Reporting, planning, data, security, and technical teams.
  • Ensure accurate and complete financial integration across Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, Plan-to-Produce, Project-to-Cash, Acquire-to-Retire, and Record-to-Report.
  • Provide Finance leadership for account determination, valuation, settlement, allocations, intercompany processing, and reporting across integrated business processes.
  • Collaborate with ABAP, integration, data, analytics, workflow, and Fiori teams on enhancements and interfaces.
  • Ensure the Finance solution aligns with the broader SAP and non-SAP landscape and enterprise architecture.

Controlling and Manufacturing Finance Support

  • Provide architecture-level guidance for Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, Material Ledger, Cost Object Controlling, Settlement, and Profitability Analysis.
  • Ensure Controlling design is integrated with Financial Accounting and aligned with business reporting and performance management needs.
  • Support manufacturing finance requirements such as inventory valuation, standard and actual costing, production variances, production order settlement, and profitability reporting.
  • Partner with specialized Controlling consultants for detailed configuration or complex industry-specific scenarios.

Practice and Team Leadership

  • Act as the central SAP Finance solution authority and trusted advisor within NTT DATA.
  • Support client assessments, pre-sales activities, proposals, estimates, solution reviews, and executive presentations.
  • Mentor Finance consultants, workstream leads, and architects and provide guidance on complex design and integration topics.
  • Develop reusable assessment frameworks, solution standards, design principles, and leading-practice content.
  • Work effectively within global onshore, nearshore, and offshore delivery models and manage multiple priorities across concurrent engagements.

Required Skills and Experience

Primary Skill: SAP Financial Accounting

  • 20+ years of SAP experience with deep functional, advisory, and solution architecture expertise in SAP Finance.
  • Strong hands-on and architecture experience in General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, Financial Close, Intercompany Accounting, parallel ledgers and currencies, document splitting, tax, statutory reporting, and financial reporting.
  • Deep understanding of S/4HANA Finance architecture, including Universal Journal, Business Partner, New Asset Accounting, embedded analytics, financial close, and SAP Fiori.
  • At least 3-5 full-cycle SAP S/4HANA transformation or implementation programs in a Finance Solution Architect, Finance Lead, or equivalent senior role.
  • Experience designing Finance solutions across multiple legal entities, currencies, countries, and accounting standards.
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial controls, compliance, statutory requirements, and management reporting.

Secondary Skill: SAP Controlling

  • Strong working knowledge of SAP Controlling and its integration with Financial Accounting.
  • Experience with Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, Material Ledger, Cost Object Controlling, Settlement, and Profitability Analysis.
  • Ability to provide architecture-level guidance for Controlling while partnering with specialized CO consultants for detailed design and configuration.
  • Understanding of manufacturing cost flows, inventory valuation, production variances, actual costing, settlement, and profitability reporting.

Finance Transformation and Industry Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of finance operating models, accounting processes, financial close, reporting, compliance, internal controls, and process governance.
  • Significant industry experience in manufacturing, including discrete and/or process manufacturing environments.
  • Experience in one or more industries such as Life Sciences, Automotive, Chemicals, Consumer Products, Retail, Utilities, Healthcare, or High Technology.
  • Experience supporting global organizations with multiple legal entities, currencies, accounting standards, and reporting requirements.
  • Ability to understand industry-specific finance requirements and translate them into practical SAP solutions.

Architecture, Advisory, and Leadership Skills

  • Proven ability to assess complex finance requirements and develop practical, scalable solution recommendations.
  • Experience leading assessments, Fit-to-Standard workshops, process harmonization, and future-state solution design.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with executive, business, functional, and technical audiences.
  • Strong understanding of Finance integration, data migration, reporting, security, controls, and custom development considerations.
  • Proven experience leading SAP Finance teams in large, complex transformation programs.
  • Strong stakeholder management, executive presence, decision facilitation, and issue-resolution skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • SAP S/4HANA Finance certification and experience with SAP Activate methodology.
  • Experience with SAP Central Finance is highly desirable.
  • Experience to Group Reporting, Advanced Financial Closing, SAP Analytics Cloud, Treasury, FSCM, or Revenue Accounting and Reporting.
  • Experience with RISE with SAP, SAP Signavio, SAP Cloud ALM, and clean-core governance.
  • Experience supporting presales, solution architecture reviews, assessments, proposals, and estimates.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Professional accounting qualifications such as CPA, CMA, CA, or equivalent is an advantage.

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical, advisory, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to effectively engage with CxOs
  • Ability to translate complex finance requirements into scalable SAP solutions.
  • Confidence working with senior finance leaders and executive stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, documentation, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to operate as both a strategic architect and a hands-on solution advisor.
  • Strong mentoring, coaching, collaboration, and client-service mindset.

Location and Work Model

  • Location: Any location in USA
  • Travel may be required based on client and delivery needs.

Minimum/Required Qualification

  • 15+ years of SAP FI/CO experience
  • 10+ years of FI/CO Solutioning / Architecture experience
  • 7+ years of S/4 HANA experience.

This range reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation for the position across all US locations. Actual compensation will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s actual work location, relevant experience, technical skills, and other qualifications. This position may also be eligible for incentive compensation based on individual and/or company performance. 

This position is eligible for company benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance with an employer contribution, flexible spending or health savings account, life and AD&D insurance, short and long term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program with company match, and additional voluntary or legally required benefits.

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. jobs.description:
Everything we do is for our customers!

Featured on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 list and G2's leaderboard, Maropost offers a unified commerce experience that our customers need, transforming ecommerce, retail, marketing automation, merchandising, helpdesk and AI operations with one platform designed to scale for fast-growing businesses. With a relentless focus on our customers’ success, we are motivated by customer obsession, extreme urgency, excellence and resourcefulness to to power 5,000+ global brands while we head to 100,000+.

Driven by the same customer-centric mentality as above, we empower businesses to achieve their goals and grow alongside us. If you're a driver and not passenger and are ready to make a significant impact and be part of our transformative journey, Maropost is the place for you.

The Opportunity:

This is the day-to-day finance seat inside a private family office that manages the investment, operating, and personal financial affairs of the principal and their family. You will own the full accounting cycle across a group of related entities — holding companies, operating companies, real-estate entities, and interests in private funds — much of it spanning more than one currency.

You will work directly with the Managing Director, close the books each month, keep the group's cash and investments accurately stated, and be the person who catches what doesn't look right before it becomes a problem. The environment is entrepreneurial and fast-moving, and a period of transition in the finance function means you will have real scope to shape process, controls, reporting, and automation from an early stage.

It is a role for a hands-on operator with the judgment of someone more senior: equal parts technical accountant, controls-minded gatekeeper, and trusted, discreet partner to the family.

What You'll be Responsible for:

  • Full-cycle accounting & the monthly close — run the close start to finish across multiple legal entities, including journal entries, accruals, intercompany transactions and eliminations, and consolidation into a clean group view.
  • Accounts payable & disbursements — own multi-currency A/P: coding and allocating invoices across entities and cost centers, applying approval thresholds and workflows, and preparing controlled wire and ACH disbursements. Screen for duplicates, misclassified or personal charges, and anything that shouldn't be paid.
  • Investment & partnership accounting — account for interests in private funds and direct investments: capital calls, distributions (distinguishing return of capital from income and realized gains), management fees, fair-value marks, and cost-basis tracking. Reconcile to custodian, fund-administrator, and capital-account statements, and track commitments and unfunded balances.
  • Multi-currency & foreign operations — maintain foreign-currency accounts and investments in a USD-reporting group: record transactions at the correct rates, revalue positions at period-end, and account for realized and unrealized foreign-exchange gains and losses.
  • Reconciliations at scale — reconcile numerous bank and brokerage accounts each month, including revenue-related accounts, deferred revenue, and accrued revenue. Resolve differences to root and keep supporting schedules audit-ready. Reconcile applicable accounts,
  • Reporting & partnership with the Managing Director — prepare and present cash, liquidity, and investment reporting; surface the decisions that need the MD's attention, clearly and concisely; and provide dedicated, discreet support across the family's business and personal financial matters.
  • Controls, policy & integration — develop and maintain accounting policies, disbursement controls, and procedures; help ensure compliance with applicable requirements; and support acquisition and entity-integration projects, bringing new entities cleanly onto the group's books and systems.
  • Automation & process improvement — a standing mandate to reduce manual effort. Identify the repetitive work — form and application preparation, reconciliations, reporting, and payment runs — and streamline it with templates, document-automation, and workflow tools, so the group's finance and administrative operations scale without adding headcount.
  • External coordination — work with outside tax advisors, auditors, and fund administrators — supplying schedules, supporting the annual cycle, and helping coordinate tax filings and information reporting.
  • provide dedicated support to the Managing Director of the Family Office.

What You'll need to bring to Maropost:

  • 8+ years of progressive full-cycle accounting experience, including hands-on ownership of the close in a multi-entity environment. (Experience scales with title — more for a Finance Manager mandate, somewhat less for a Senior Accountant framing.)
  • Family office, fund or private-equity exposure strongly preferred — you understand how investment entities and personal/family finances fit together.
  • Solid grasp of investment and partnership accounting: capital calls and distributions, management fees, fair value, and reconciling to fund-admin and custodian statements.
  • Comfort with multi-currency accounting — recording, revaluation, and realized vs. unrealized FX.
  • Strong accounts-payable discipline at volume, with a controls-first, detail-oriented mindset.
  • CPA / CA preferred; a public-accounting or audit background is a plus for the controls discipline a family office requires.
  • Proficiency with an ERP or full accounting system (e.g., NetSuite, Sage Intacct, or QuickBooks Enterprise) and genuinely strong Excel (pivots, lookups, reconciliation builds).
  • A bias toward automation — a track record of turning repetitive finance and administrative tasks into repeatable, low-touch processes, and comfort with automation or workflow tools (e.g., document automation, Zapier / Make, RPA) or light scripting.
  • Discretion and sound judgment — you will see the family's private financial affairs and are trusted to handle them with complete confidentiality.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • You exemplify Maropost’s Values:

    o Customer Obsessed

    o Extreme Urgency

    o Excellence
    o Resourceful

Message from the Founders: Maropost is looking for builders - people who want to drive our business forward at all costs in order to achieve the goals we have both short and long term for the results and outcomes that that will bring to us all.

If that isn't for you that’s ok, for those of you that it is please get in touch with us!
