jobs.description:
About the Role:

We are looking for a Senior Editor, Research & Intelligence to help us understand what our audience actually cares about and turn that into content, products, and measurable audience growth.

This role sits at the center of our audience and editorial strategy. Your job is to gather real-world input from interviews, surveys, events, strategic partners, and market activity, and turn it into clear insights that shape what we publish, what we build, and how we grow our subscriber base.

This is not a traditional editing role. It is about identifying patterns, making sense of information, and helping the organization make better decisions based on real audience needs.

Your work will directly improve content quality, increase conversion, and drive audience growth.

Who You Are:

    You are someone who naturally asks, “What is actually going on here?” and then goes and finds the answer.

    You are comfortable working with both qualitative and quantitative inputs, including conversations, interviews, survey data, partner insights, and performance data, and turning them into something useful and clear.

    You do not just collect information. You connect dots, spot patterns, and explain what it means and what to do next.

    You are also a strong editor and communicator. You can take complex ideas and make them simple, structured, and actionable.

    You do not stop at insight. You push through to what should happen next.

What You’ll Be Doing:

    1. Build a clear understanding of our audience: You will lead how we gather insight about senior decision-makers across our brands.
    • Run surveys and research to capture first-party data
    • Conduct and synthesize editorial interviews and expert conversations
    • Pull insights from events, community discussions, and market activity
    • Gather and synthesize insights from strategic partners and external collaborators
    • Identify patterns in what our audience cares about, struggles with, and prioritizes
      • Your goal is to build a consistent, reliable view of what matters most to our audience.
    2. Turn inputs into clear, usable insights: You will take what we learn and turn it into direction.
    • Translate research and observations into clear insights tied to decisions
    • Bring together internal data and partner insights into a single point of view
    • Connect insights directly to recommended actions and expected outcomes
    • Translate insights into clear reports and briefings that leadership and teams can act on
    • Inform editorial direction, content strategy, and audience targeting
    • Ensure major initiatives are grounded in real audience understanding
      • Your work should answer: What does this mean, and what should we do differently because of it?
    3. Lead insight-driven content and research: You will create the outputs that demonstrate our authority and drive audience growth.
    • Develop reports, surveys, and insight-driven content
    • Partner with strategic partners on co-created research and intelligence projects
    • Support experiences designed to convert readers into subscribers, including interactive tools and insight-driven email content
    • Package findings into formats that attract and convert subscribers
    • Ensure insight-driven content and research directly contribute to subscriber growth
    • Partner with revenue, sponsorship, and events teams to ensure this work supports commercial opportunities
      • These outputs should drive credibility, subscriber growth, and measurable performance.
    4. Measure performance and make recommendations that drive audience growth: You will own how insight-driven work is evaluated and improved, with a clear focus on driving audience growth.
    • Define how we measure the performance of insight-driven content and experiences
    • Track and analyze performance to understand what is driving subscriber growth and what is not
    • Make clear, actionable recommendations tied directly to audience growth

Under limited supervision, the Sr. Investigator & Employee Relations Consultant has primary responsibility for leading and conducting highly complex, high-risk workplace investigations involving allegations of discrimination, harassment, retaliation, unfair treatment, violations of company policy or law, leaves of absence/ADA, conflicts of interest, workplace conduct, and other matters involving significant legal or organizational risk.

This position independently leads investigations from intake through conclusion, including developing investigative strategy, conducting interviews, analyzing evidence, determining findings, preparing investigative summaries, and communicating findings. Effectively partners cross-functionally with Legal, Employee Relations Consultants, HR Business Partners, Compliance, and business leadership to ensure thorough, impartial, and legally defensible investigations.

Additionally, this position provides consultation and guidance to management on complex employee relations issues, including disciplinary actions, involuntary terminations, coaching, conflict resolution, performance concerns, and other employment-related matters.

What You Will Do

  • Lead and independently manage all Title VII, discrimination, harassment, retaliation, and other complex, high-risk workplace investigations from intake through final resolution, including defining investigative strategy, interviewing reporting parties, respondents, witnesses, and other involved individuals; gathering and analyzing relevant documentation; and reaching objective, legally defensible conclusions.

  • Determine and apply the appropriate legal standards in assessing and investigating allegations of discrimination, harassment, retaliation, and other violations of company policy while ensuring investigations are conducted objectively, impartially, timely, and consistently.

  • Prepare clear, concise, and comprehensive investigative summaries that accurately capture allegations, evidence, analysis, factual findings, conclusions, and recommended actions. Present investigation findings through effective oral and written communication to Human Resources, Legal, and business leadership.

  • Exercise discretion, sound judgment, critical thinking, and analytical skills while managing highly sensitive and confidential investigations involving allegations of discrimination, retaliation, Title VII policy violations, and other complex employment matters.

  • Independently manage a significant caseload of complex investigations while balancing competing priorities, maintaining confidentiality, meeting established timelines, and ensuring a positive employee experience throughout the investigative process.

  • Partner with and provide consultation to management on employee relations matters, including investigating complaints, evaluating performance concerns, initiating disciplinary actions (including involuntary terminations), and conflict resolution.

  • Maintain a comprehensive understanding of federal, state, and municipal employment laws and regulations to ensure compliance, mitigate organizational risk, and support sound employment decisions.

  • Provide coaching and conflict resolution to managers and employees by utilizing a strong understanding of business needs, company culture, employment law, and organizational objectives.

  • Analyze employee relations and investigation data to identify trends, systemic concerns, and organizational risks. Develop recommendations and proactive solutions to reduce future risk.

  • Foster collaborative partnerships with Centers of Excellence (COEs), HR Business Partners, Legal, Compliance, business leaders, managers, and associates to build trusted relationships and drive consistent, fair, and compliant employment practices.

What You Will Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Employment Law, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Minimum of 6–8 years of progressively responsible experience conducting complex workplace investigations involving Title VII, discrimination, harassment, retaliation, and other high-risk employment matters, including strong Human Resources Employee Relations experience, preferably within a financial services or other highly regulated industry.

  • Demonstrated experience leading independent workplace investigations from intake through conclusion, including interviewing complainants, respondents, and witnesses; analyzing evidence; preparing investigative summaries; and presenting findings to leadership.

  • Employee Relations consulting experience supporting managers on complex employment matters, disciplinary actions, involuntary terminations, and conflict resolution.

  • In-depth knowledge of federal, state, and local employment laws, including Title VII, ADA, FMLA, and other applicable employment and non-discrimination laws.

  • Ability to independently manage highly complex and confidential matters, organize work effectively, prioritize competing responsibilities, exercise sound judgment, and make objective decisions based on facts, applicable law, and company policy.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage confidential information, conduct impartial investigations, and independently manage a significant investigative caseload.

  • Excellent writing skills with demonstrated ability to prepare clear, concise, thorough, and professionally written investigative summaries for leadership and legal review.

  • Excellent interpersonal, interviewing, communication, influencing, and collaboration skills.

  • Strong presentation skills with the ability to communicate complex investigative findings, recommendations, trends, and organizational risks to leaders at all levels.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.

What Will Set You Apart

  • Legal background.

  • Juris Doctor (JD).

  • PHR, SPHR, SHRM-SCP, or comparable professional certification.

  • Experience within a financial services or other highly regulated industry.

Vermont Rural Healthcare Finance and Revenue Cycle Leadership Opportunities

Explore Rural Healthcare Opportunities at RSSJobs.org

This application may connect you with the specific opportunity you were viewing, as well as other current or upcoming rural healthcare leadership positions throughout Vermont.

To explore additional rural healthcare opportunities and communities, visit:

Rural Staffing Services® partners with rural hospitals, clinics, community health centers, long-term care organizations, and healthcare systems throughout Vermont to identify experienced finance and revenue cycle leaders who understand the unique realities of rural healthcare.

We are currently connecting with professionals who may be interested in active and upcoming finance, accounting, reimbursement, revenue cycle, billing, coding, and patient financial services leadership opportunities across Vermont.

These opportunities may include leadership within Critical Access Hospitals, rural and community hospitals, Rural Health Clinics, Federally Qualified Health Centers, long-term care organizations, and integrated rural healthcare systems.

This Is More Than a Finance Role

Strong financial and revenue cycle operations help protect healthcare access for an entire rural community.

These leaders ensure organizations can accurately capture revenue, manage resources responsibly, support employees, maintain compliance, and remain financially strong enough to continue caring for the people who depend on them.

In a rural healthcare organization, finance and revenue cycle leaders often work across departments and may have broader responsibilities than they would in a larger system.

The strongest leaders understand how registration, coding, billing, reimbursement, patient accounts, accounting, and operational decisions connect to one another.

They are collaborative, detail-oriented, approachable, and able to turn complex financial information into practical guidance for employees, department leaders, executives, and governing boards.

Opportunities May Include

This application may connect you with current or upcoming roles such as:

Controller

Assistant Controller

Finance Director or Manager

Accounting Director or Manager
Revenue Cycle Director or Manager
Patient Financial Services Director or Manager
Patient Accounts Manager
Business Office Director or Manager
Billing Director or Manager
Coding Director, Manager, or Supervisor
Health Information Management Revenue Cycle Leader
Reimbursement Director or Manager
Chargemaster or Charge Description Master Leader
Accounts Payable or Accounts Receivable Leader
Payroll Leader
Senior billing, coding, or patient accounts supervisory roles

Available positions, organizations, and locations will vary as new needs arise throughout Vermont.

What You May Lead

Responsibilities will vary by organization and position and may include:

Leading accounting, finance, revenue cycle, billing, coding, or patient financial services functions
Supporting accurate and timely financial reporting
Managing month-end and year-end close processes
Developing budgets, forecasts, and financial performance reports
Strengthening billing, collections, cash flow, and reimbursement performance
Monitoring key revenue cycle metrics and identifying opportunities for improvement
Supporting accurate coding, charge capture, claims submission, and payment posting
Overseeing patient accounts, financial counseling, and collection processes
Ensuring compliance with payer, regulatory, accounting, and documentation requirements
Preparing for financial, coding, billing, or compliance audits
Developing policies, procedures, workflows, and internal controls
Training and supporting finance and revenue cycle employees
Collaborating with clinical, operational, IT, HIM, and executive leaders
Helping employees understand how their work affects organizational sustainability
Supporting system implementations, process improvements, or departmental restructuring

What You May Bring

Qualifications will vary by opportunity, but organizations may seek:

Progressive experience in healthcare finance, accounting, revenue cycle, billing, coding, reimbursement, or patient financial services
Previous leadership experience as a director, manager, controller, supervisor, or comparable leader
Knowledge of healthcare reimbursement, payer requirements, billing practices, and financial operations
Experience with Medicare, Medicaid, commercial insurance, and patient-pay accounts
An understanding of hospital, clinic, or healthcare-system workflows
Experience analyzing financial or revenue cycle performance and communicating findings to leadership
Strong organizational, problem-solving, and team-development skills
Experience within rural hospitals, Critical Access Hospitals, FQHCs, long-term care organizations, or community healthcare settings
Relevant education or professional credentials based on the position
A collaborative and relationship-focused leadership style

Some opportunities may prefer credentials such as CPA, CHFP, CRCR, CPC, CCS, RHIA, RHIT, or other finance, coding, revenue cycle, or health information certifications. Requirements will depend on the specific role.

Why Rural Vermont?

Vermont's rural healthcare organizations serve communities shaped by the Green Mountains, forests, farmland, rivers, historic villages, and close-knit towns.

These organizations frequently operate with lean teams, limited resources, and a tremendous responsibility to the communities they serve.

Finance and revenue cycle leadership in a rural Vermont organization provides the opportunity to see the direct impact of your work.

Improving a process, supporting a team, or strengthening reimbursement can help preserve services, protect jobs, improve the patient experience, and keep care available close to home.

Join the RSS Rural Talent Network

By applying through this page, you are joining the confidential Rural Staffing Services talent network.

You may be considered for current or upcoming finance and revenue cycle leadership opportunities that align with your background, goals, location preferences, and availability.

Please include your resume and let us know:

Which Vermont communities or regions you would consider

Whether you are open to relocation

Whether you are interested in permanent, interim, remote, fractional, or multiple types of opportunities
Which areas best match your experience, such as accounting, finance, billing, coding, reimbursement, patient accounts, or full revenue cycle
Your experience with rural hospitals, Critical Access Hospitals, FQHCs, long-term care organizations, or community healthcare settings
Which position or community you were viewing on RSSJobs.org

Our team personally reviews each application. When we identify an opportunity that may be a strong match, we will contact you directly to share more about the organization, community, responsibilities, and next steps.

Even when the right opportunity is not available today, we would value the opportunity to learn more about you and stay connected as new finance and revenue cycle leadership needs arise throughout Vermont.

Your information will be handled professionally and confidentially.

Discover More Rural Healthcare Opportunities

Visit to explore additional rural healthcare leadership opportunities and communities.

Finance Manager - Remote

Location: Remote
Working Hours: Gulf Standard Time (Abu Dhabi time zone)
Reports to: Chief Financial Officer
Function: Finance and Fund Operations

Role Overview

We are seeking a hands-on Finance Manager to take operational ownership of the finance function under the direction of the CFO.

The role covers financial reporting, reconciliations, fund valuations, taxation, treasury, regulatory capital calculations, payroll and audit coordination across the business, its funds and associated Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs).

The Finance Manager will prepare and manage the day-to-day finance activities, with the CFO providing review and approval.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Management

  • Prepare monthly management reports and financial statements in accordance with IFRS.
  • Manage monthly bank, balance sheet and intercompany reconciliations.
  • Prepare UAE Corporate Tax returns, VAT filings and FATCA/CRS reports for CFO review and approval.
  • Manage day-to-day treasury and cash operations within approved policies.
  • Prepare monthly regulatory capital adequacy calculations.
  • Process payroll and maintain Wage Protection System compliance.
  • Maintain accurate, complete and audit-ready financial records.

Fund and SPV Operations

  • Conduct quarterly fair-value assessments across fund and SPV portfolios.
  • Prepare Net Asset Value calculations.
  • Maintain Limited Partner capital accounts.
  • Account for capital calls and distributions.
  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for external auditors.
  • Maintain accurate books and records using Xero.
  • Promptly escalate financial-control, data-integrity and reporting deadline risks to the CFO.

Candidate Requirements

Experience

  • Approximately 4–7 years of relevant finance experience, including at least two years post-qualification.
  • Experience in private equity, venture capital, fund administration or asset management is strongly preferred.
  • Strong exposure to IFRS and fund/SPV accounting.
  • Knowledge of UAE Corporate Tax, VAT and FATCA/CRS is advantageous.
  • Experience supporting audits and maintaining regulatory compliance.

Systems

  • Hands-on Xero experience is strongly preferred.
  • Comfortable working with integrated and highly automated finance systems.
  • Strong spreadsheet, reporting and financial-analysis skills.

Personal Attributes

  • Collaborative, proactive and solutions-focused.
  • Able to identify gaps and take ownership of resolving them.
  • Comfortable working independently within a small, distributed team.
  • Willing to support colleagues outside the immediate scope of the role when needed.
  • Highly disciplined in meeting monthly and quarterly deadlines.
  • Strong attention to detail, confidentiality and record-keeping standards.

Working Arrangement

This is a remote position requiring the successful candidate to:

  • Maintain core working hours aligned with Gulf Standard Time.
  • Work effectively and independently in a remote environment.
  • Travel to Abu Dhabi periodically when required.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality when handling sensitive company, investor and portfolio information.

How to Apply

Candidates who closely match the requirements and demonstrate strong capability are encouraged to apply. Responsibilities may be adjusted based on the successful candidate's experience and strengths.

jobs.description:
About Orium

Orium builds smart, modern commerce solutions that help enterprise brands move faster and stay ahead.

By bringing together AI, data, and composable systems, we create experiences designed for collaboration between people and intelligent agents— helping our clients work more efficiently, adapt quickly, and gain a long-term competitive edge.

With more composable launches than any firm in the Americas and deep expertise across commerce architecture, we partner with leading technology providers to deliver scalable solutions that evolve with our clients and accelerate time to value.

We blend systems thinking, data-driven design, and intelligent delivery, embedding AI and agents into our own teams to move faster, reduce friction, and co-create with greater precision. The result: adaptive, cross-channel experiences that keep our clients ahead of what’s next.

About the Opportunity

Orium is entering a new phase of growth, where expanding and deepening existing client relationships is as critical as acquiring new ones.

We’re hiring a Head of Accounts to define and lead how we grow, manage, and scale our current client portfolio. This is a strategic leadership role responsible for transforming account management into a disciplined, insight-driven, and AI-enabled function that consistently drives customer lifetime value. This role owns the account growth engine end-to-end: team leadership, commercial outcomes, and the operating discipline needed to convert expansion opportunities and ensure Orium has a repeatable approach to account planning, forecasting, and sales operations.

You will manage Account Managers and work closely with Delivery, Line of Business Owners, Marketing, and Sales leadership to ensure current accounts are actively managed, forecasted, and expanded, bringing structure to how Orium grows existing relationships through account playbooks, expansion plans, quarterly forecasts, and bookings targets.

This person must be a strong consultant in their own right — someone who can sit across from a client’s VP of Digital or CTO, understand their business challenges, and map those challenges to commercial opportunities without relying on internal subject matter experts to carry the conversation. They should be comfortable leading strategic planning discussions, challenging a client’s assumptions, and building a case for investment based on business outcomes.

A core mandate of this role is scaling the practical use of AI across the account management function to improve team efficiency, effectiveness, and quality, and to help clients connect AI-enabled opportunities to measurable business outcomes. This means going beyond process improvement. This role uses AI to surface account risks early, identify the right commercial move at the right moment, and turn account data into revenue action.

Responsibilities

Personal Account Ownership

  • Carry a personal portfolio of 5–8 priority accounts, serving as the primary commercial relationship owner and demonstrating the standard of account management the team is expected to deliver.
  • Drive expansion and renewal conversations at meaningful deal sizes ($200K–$500K+), personally navigating complex client organizations, building multi-stakeholder relationships, and closing commercial opportunities.
  • Use personal account work to model the consultative selling, objection handling, and proactive commercial engagement the broader team is being coached to develop.

Account Growth & Portfolio Strategy

  • Own the strategy for growing Orium’s existing client portfolio, with accountability for expansion revenue and lifetime value.
  • Identify, prioritize, and drive expansion opportunities across accounts, , including cross-LOB expansion (Commerce to DXP, DXP to Agentic), partner-driven joint plays (commercetools, Stripe, Contentstack), transition of project-based clients into ongoing optimization or managed service relationships, and long-term partnership growth.
  • Establish account-level growth strategies for priority clients, including relationship mapping, opportunity hypotheses, and commercial targets.
  • Partner with Sales, Delivery, and LOB leaders to convert account insights into executable growth plans.
  • Monitor account health, client satisfaction, delivery performance, and commercial potential to proactively manage risk and opportunity.
  • Elevate client relationships to executive-level partnerships, positioning Orium as a long-term strategic advisor.
  • Frame AI as a driver of customer outcomes, helping clients understand how AI can support measurable business goals such as increased revenue, improved conversion, lower operational costs, better customer experiences, and faster execution.

Account Operating Model & Playbooks

  • Define and implement Orium’s account management playbooks, including standards for account planning, business reviews, relationship management, renewal motions, expansion planning, and risk mitigation.
  • Create a consistent operating rhythm for managing current accounts across the business.
  • Establish clear expectations for how account teams identify opportunities, document account intelligence, manage stakeholders, and progress expansion conversations.
  • Improve visibility into account activity, pipeline, and next steps across Orium’s leadership team.
  • Build scalable playbooks, templates, and tools that improve consistency without adding unnecessary complexity.

AI-Enabled Account Management

  • Design and implement an AI-enabled account management function that increases scale, quality, and efficiency. This would focus on outcomes such as: earlier risk detection, faster opportunity identification, and higher conversion across the portfolio.
  • Embed AI and agentic workflows across account research, opportunity identification, forecasting, and meeting preparation. Use these to surface next best actions, track client sentiment, and flag at-risk accounts before they escalate.
  • Develop reusable, AI-supported assets such as account plans, growth frameworks, and expansion playbooks.
  • Build and operationalize AI-assisted workflows, including account research, meeting preparation, follow-up, and opportunity tracking that raise the consistency and quality of account team output.
  • Replace manual tracking with automated account monitoring and AI-prioritized action lists, so no expansion opportunity or at-risk account goes unnoticed.

jobs.description:
Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a highly driven, execution-focused professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Senior Operations Manager opening.

As the Senior Operations Manager, you are the company's logistics engine — owning and driving end-to-end execution across suppliers, freight, inventory, and fulfillment. You don't just manage operations — you obsess over them. Every shipment is tracked, every forwarder is held accountable, and every purchase order is placed with full awareness of its financial impact.

You lead by doing — raising the execution bar of the team through hands-on involvement, system building, and continuous improvement. You actively leverage AI, not as a tool, but as a core operational layer — building systems, automations, and workflows that improve visibility, accuracy, and decision-making.

This is not a role for someone who wants to maintain what exists. It is for someone hungry to improve, optimize, and prove they can operate at a high-performance level.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.

Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities:

Own Supply Chain Execution & Pipeline Visibility

  • Maintain live pipeline visibility at all times — including China warehouse status, vessels in transit (ETD/ETA), and inventory received stateside. The pipeline never surprises the business.
  • Deliver month-end inventory snapshots and quarter-end reconciliations to finance without being asked.
  • Ensure AI systems automatically flag anomalies across the pipeline (delays, mismatches, risks).
  • Ensure 100% on-time product launches, QC pass rate >98% on first inspection, and On Time In Full (OTIF) >95% by Month 6.
  • Maintain >98% in-stock rate on top revenue SKUs, aged inventory <8% of total units, and drive inventory turns toward 5–8x annually.
  • Secure a minimum of 3 freight quotes per booking and ensure no forwarder is retained without performance data (ETD accuracy, delays, cost benchmarks).
  • Maintain and update a rolling 12-week supply plan, with AI-driven risk detection and reorder triggers before stockouts occur.

Drive Financial Discipline in Operations

  • Maintain a standing financial analysis for every active supplier — including cash flow impact, landed cost, and MOQ trade-offs — continuously updated via AI-powered tools.
  • Ensure no purchase order is committed to excess inventory without documented financial justification.
  • Track landed cost against target COGS on every order.
  • Deliver a monthly operations cost summary (freight, duty, storage, COGS trends) — compiled and formatted automatically via AI tools.
  • Ensure 100% application of Nairobi Protocol and all applicable duty exemptions.
  • Build and maintain an AI system that verifies HS codes and eligibility before every freight booking — zero exceptions.

Build SOPs & Scalable Systems

  • Conduct a full operational audit within the first 60 days, clearly identifying what is working, broken, missing, and where AI can enhance execution.
  • First 30 days are dedicated to learning, not restructuring, followed by a prioritized improvement roadmap presented to the Head of Operations.
  • Ensure all SOPs are documented, tested, live in Asana, and followed without supervision.
  • Audit every SOP for AI acceleration opportunities.
  • Build and implement at least 2 AI-powered tools within the first 6 months, and document and hand them off as repeatable team processes.
  • Ensure SOPs are reviewed quarterly and continuously optimized.

Own DTC Fulfillment & Inventory Strategy

  • Ensure all supply planning accounts for total demand across all channels (Amazon, DTC, wholesale, and emerging channels) — no decision is made without a full demand picture.
  • Maintain an AI-powered demand model that continuously updates forecasts and surfaces risks.
  • Ensure DTC and Amazon inventory pools never compete for the same units, with AI monitoring stock levels and reorder thresholds.
  • Own DTC fulfillment performance end-to-end — cost, lead time, and service level — escalating issues with proposed solutions before customer impact.

Lead and Develop the Operations Team

  • Assess all team members within the first 30 days, identifying strengths, gaps, and development needs.
  • Define clear ownership and weekly KPIs for each team member, ensuring accountability and independent execution.
  • Address performance gaps within 7 days — no prolonged underperformance.
  • Ensure no team member requires daily oversight on core responsibilities.
  • Coach the team on financial awareness and AI adoption, ensuring each team member delivers at least one AI-driven workflow improvement within the first 6 months.

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Amazon FBA operations, including shipment creation, AWD, inventory management, and compliance.
  • Proven experience managing overseas suppliers (preferably China), booking freight with multiple forwarders, and handling customs and duty optimization.
  • Strong experience managing inventory across multiple fulfillment channels, with a track record of maintaining high in-stock rates and controlling aged inventory.
  • Experience leading and managing a team (minimum 2 direct reports), with clear evidence of accountability and performance management.
  • Proven experience building, following, and improving SOPs and operational processes.
  • Hands-on experience building AI tools, automations, or workflows is strongly preferred.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to detail: does not let important details slip through the cracks or derail a project.
  • Commitment (Work ethic): possesses a strong willingness to work hard and sometimes long hours to get the job done.
  • Consistency (Persistency): demonstrates tenacity and willingness to go the distance to get something done.
  • Growth (Growth mindset): continuously seeks to learn, improve, and grow.
  • Problem solver (Proactivity): acts without being told what to do and brings new ideas.
  • Trust (Honesty/integrity): operates with transparency and high ethical standards.

Leadership Competencies:

  • Efficiency: builds systems that maximize output and eliminate wasted effort.
  • Analytical skills: applies financial thinking to every operational decision.
  • Organization & Planning: manages multiple complex workflows without failure.
  • Calm under pressure: maintains performance and clarity in high-stress situations.
  • High standards: operates with a zero-error mindset on execution and reporting.
  • Enthusiasm: brings energy and passion for logistics, AI, and operational excellence.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Direct ownership of critical operations and supply chain performance.
  • High impact role with significant autonomy and decision-making power.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored company trips.
  • Quarterly performance-based bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for an operations leader who thrives in high-performance environments, combines analytical thinking with execution excellence, and is driven by ownership, accountability, and continuous optimization.

jobs.excerpt: For over 90 years, Topcon’s vision has been to solve societal challenges around the globe.
jobs.description:
For over 90 years, Topcon’s vision has been to solve societal challenges around the globe. In healthcare, we are developing innovations that improve patients’ health and quality of life.

We empower eye care providers with advanced imaging, diagnostic solutions, and intelligent data technology. Our robotic devices deliver simplicity without compromise, by capturing clear images with the push of a button.

By joining Topcon Healthcare, you become part of a growing, diverse, global team. With office locations throughout North America, whether you are on-site, remote, or hybrid, our culture empowers you to contribute to company and personal success each day. At Topcon Healthcare, you can grow your career, gain new perspectives, and help address society’s most pressing challenges. If you have drive, passion, and a desire to be part of a collaborative team, we want to hear from you.

At Topcon Healthcare, we don’t wait for the future. We invent it. Join us.

Learn more about working with us at topconcareers.com

The Industry Solutions Executive (ISE), Connected Care is a senior field-based solutions leader responsible for advancing Topcon Healthcare's connected-care strategy within the corporate optometry market.
The ISE serves as the connective tissue between corporate optometry customers and Topcon's commercial organization—translating Topcon's connected-care portfolio into enterprise-ready, end-to-end workflows that create measurable value for providers, patients, health plans, employers, and healthcare systems.
This individual acts as a strategic advisor to some of the largest OD, OMD, and vision care networks in the country, helping customers leverage Harmony®, IRIS®, AI-enabled insights, and connected-care technologies to enhance clinical outcomes, improve operational performance, expand screening and monitoring capabilities, and unlock new opportunities for value-based and data-driven healthcare delivery.
The role also serves as a key partner to Topcon's Strategic Account Managers, Software Sales Representatives, and Instrument Sales Representatives, equipping commercial teams with the solution narratives, business cases, and customer-facing assets needed to position enterprise-wide connected-care solutions. Success in this role requires building trusted executive relationships, creating repeatable commercial plays, enabling field teams to confidently position the connected-care platform, and helping establish Topcon as a market leader in connected eye care and healthcare through the eye.
This is not a traditional account executive or product management role. The Industry Solutions Executive operates at the intersection of corporate optometry strategy, enterprise solution selling, clinical workflow transformation, and commercial enablement.
Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Connected Care Strategy & Market Development

  • Define connected-care solution strategies and value propositions for the corporate optometry segment, including national and regional OD/OMD organizations, optical retail networks, and managed vision organizations.
  • Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Commercial, Regulatory, and Implementation teams to ensure customer needs are reflected in solution development and go-to-market priorities.
  • Shape market-facing solution narratives that help customers understand the value of connected eye care, disease screening, data-driven care delivery, and population health initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to expand the role of eye care within broader healthcare delivery models.
  • Serve as a voice of the customer, helping inform product direction, workflow design, and commercial packaging through direct market engagement.

Enterprise Customer Engagement

  • Lead executive-level discovery and opportunity development for complex enterprise healthcare organizations.
  • Engage C-suite executives, medical directors, clinical leaders, and operational stakeholders to align connected-care solutions with business and clinical objectives.
  • Develop executive business cases tied to measurable clinical, operational, financial, and population health outcomes.
  • Build and maintain trusted executive-level relationships within strategic corporate optometry and vision care organizations.
  • Leverage key opinion leader (KOL) relationships and market expertise to support customer engagement and solution adoption.

Solution Design & Workflow Transformation

  • Translate customer goals and operational requirements into deployable connected-care solutions that leverage Harmony®, IRIS®, imaging technologies, AI-enabled decision support, analytics, and digital workflows.
  • Help customers implement scalable approaches to diabetic retinopathy screening, chronic disease monitoring, care coordination, and preventive health initiatives.
  • Support the development of new care pathways and operational models that improve patient outcomes, increase screening capacity, and enhance practice performance.
  • Convert successful customer engagements into repeatable commercial playbooks that can be leveraged across the market.

Examples may include:
  • Supporting enterprise-wide Harmony deployments across multi-location optometry networks to unify imaging, workflow, AI, and data management.
  • Integrating diabetic retinopathy screening programs into referral and care coordination pathways.
  • Activating data-driven screening, monitoring, and analytics capabilities across provider networks.
  • Developing connected-care models that create value for providers, health plans, employers, and healthcare organizations.

Sales Partnership & Commercial Enablement

  • Partner with Strategic Account Managers and commercial teams on priority corporate optometry pursuits.
  • Co-develop account strategies and participate in executive customer meetings, workshops, and solution discussions.
  • Create customer-facing assets that support enterprise solution selling, including:
    • Solution narratives
    • Executive presentations
    • ROI and business value models
    • Demonstration workflows
    • Customer reference stories
    • Industry use cases
  • Help expand customer conversations from individual products and technologies into broader connected-care platform opportunities.
  • Develop repeatable commercial solution plays and customer success stories that can be leveraged broadly across the sales organization.
  • Enable field teams through scalable tools, ROI models, executive presentations, business-value frameworks, and strategic guidance that support enterprise-level selling.
  • Foster a collaborative co-sell culture across software, instrumentation, and strategic account teams.

Thought Leadership

  • Represent Topcon Healthcare within the corporate optometry, vision care, and connected-healthcare communities.
  • Participate in executive briefings, industry conferences, advisory boards, and customer forums.
  • Build relationships with key opinion leaders and industry stakeholders.
  • Support thought leadership initiatives designed to advance the adoption of connected care and healthcare through the eye.
  • Lead planning and execution of Topcon's annual insights conference, bringing together healthcare leaders to discuss innovation, outcomes, and the future of connected eye care.
  • Help strengthen Topcon Healthcare's position as a leader in connected eye care, population health, and healthcare through the eye.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 10+ years of experience in healthcare, health technology, medical devices, healthcare software, digital health, or related industries.
  • Proven experience in enterprise commercial, strategic sales, business development, solutions consulting, or market development roles.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise opportunities involving executive decision-makers.
  • Experience developing business cases, value propositions, executive presentations, and customer-facing sales tools.
  • Strong communication, presentation, facilitation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively within a field sales organization and influence outcomes in a matrixed environment.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 50%.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in optometry, ophthalmology, vision care, retinal imaging, diagnostics, or related healthcare specialties.
  • Experience selling enterprise SaaS platforms, clinical workflow solutions, healthcare data platforms, healthcare analytics solutions, or AI-enabled technologies.
  • Experience working with corporate optometry organizations, optical retail networks, managed vision organizations, health systems, or other multi-site healthcare networks.
  • Knowledge of diabetic retinopathy screening programs, population health initiatives, care coordination models, remote care strategies, and healthcare interoperability.
  • Familiarity with FDA-regulated software solutions, clinical decision support technologies, or emerging applications of oculomics and healthcare analytics.
  • Demonstrated ability to create and scale solution narratives, ROI models, demo workflows, and other commercial assets that enable successful enterprise selling.

jobs.title: Wyoming Rural Management, Social Work and Care Coordination Opportunities
jobs.excerpt: Wyoming Rural Healthcare Case Management, Social Work and Care Coordination OpportunitiesRural Staffing Services partners with rural hospitals, clinics, public hospital districts, and community healthcare organizations throughout Wyoming to identify experienced leaders and professionals in case management, social work, utilization review, discharge planning, and care coordination.
jobs.description:
Wyoming Rural Healthcare Case Management, Social Work and Care Coordination Opportunities

Rural Staffing Services partners with rural hospitals, clinics, public hospital districts, and community healthcare organizations throughout Wyoming to identify experienced leaders and professionals in case management, social work, utilization review, discharge planning, and care coordination.

We are currently connecting with professionals who may be interested in active and upcoming case management, social work, utilization management, discharge planning, and care coordination opportunities across Wyoming.

These opportunities may include positions within Critical Access Hospitals, community hospitals, Rural Health Clinics, Federally Qualified Health Centers, public hospital districts, long-term care organizations, and integrated rural healthcare systems.

Explore Rural Healthcare Opportunities at RSSJobs.org

This application may connect you with the specific opportunity you were viewing, as well as other current or upcoming rural healthcare positions throughout Wyoming that align with your experience and goals.

Visit to explore additional rural healthcare opportunities and communities.

This Is More Than a Care Coordination Role

In rural healthcare, helping a patient safely move through the healthcare system often requires creativity, persistence, and strong community relationships.

Case management, social work, and care coordination professionals help connect patients and families with the clinical care, resources, education, and support they need. They may address barriers involving transportation, housing, insurance, behavioral health, long-term care, family support, or access to specialty services far from home.

The strongest professionals understand that a discharge plan is more than paperwork. It is a bridge between the hospital, the patient's home, local providers, community resources, and the next stage of care.

Opportunities May Include

This application may connect you with current or upcoming roles such as:

  • Director or Manager of Case Management
  • Case Management Supervisor
  • Hospital Case Manager
  • Social Work Director or Manager
  • Medical Social Worker
  • Care Coordination Director or Manager
  • Care Coordinator
  • Utilization Review or Utilization Management Director
  • Utilization Review Nurse
  • Discharge Planning Manager
  • Discharge Planner
  • Transitions of Care Manager
  • Population Health Manager
  • Community Health Program Manager
  • Complex Care Manager
  • Patient Navigation Leadership
  • Senior case management, social work, or care coordination roles

What You May Lead or Support

Responsibilities will vary by organization and position and may include:

  • Coordinating safe and appropriate patient transitions
  • Developing discharge and follow-up care plans
  • Assessing clinical, social, financial, and community needs
  • Connecting patients and families with local and regional resources
  • Collaborating with physicians, nurses, therapists, behavioral health professionals, and community partners
  • Supporting utilization review, medical necessity, and level-of-care processes
  • Communicating with payers and supporting authorization or denial-management processes
  • Reducing avoidable readmissions and delays in care
  • Supporting patients with complex medical or social needs
  • Coordinating referrals to home health, skilled nursing, rehabilitation, hospice, behavioral health, or specialty care
  • Helping patients navigate insurance, transportation, housing, medication, and other barriers
  • Developing policies, procedures, workflows, and documentation standards
  • Monitoring quality, outcomes, length of stay, and departmental performance
  • Leading, mentoring, and supporting case management or social work teams
  • Building stronger connections between the healthcare organization and the community

What You Will Bring

Qualifications will vary by opportunity, but organizations may seek:

  • Experience in case management, medical social work, utilization review, discharge planning, care coordination, or population health
  • Previous leadership experience for director, manager, or supervisory opportunities
  • Knowledge of healthcare delivery, payer requirements, medical necessity, and patient transitions
  • Experience working with patients and families facing complex clinical or social needs
  • Strong communication, assessment, advocacy, and problem-solving skills
  • The ability to collaborate across clinical, operational, and community teams
  • Experience with rural hospitals, Critical Access Hospitals, FQHCs, public hospital districts, long-term care, or community healthcare organizations
  • Relevant education, licensure, or certification based on the position
  • A compassionate, resourceful, and relationship-focused approach

Some opportunities may require or prefer credentials such as RN, LMSW, LCSW, ACM, CCM, or another case management, nursing, or social work credential. Requirements will depend on the specific position.

Why Rural Wyoming?

Wyoming's rural healthcare organizations serve communities surrounded by mountains, high plains, ranchlands, rivers, open roads, and wide-open spaces. Long distances, limited transportation, workforce shortages, and fewer local services can make care transitions especially challenging.

Working in case management, social work, or care coordination in a rural setting offers the opportunity to help patients overcome real barriers, strengthen community connections, and make care feel more coordinated and humane.

Join the RSS Rural Talent Network

By applying through this page, you are joining the confidential Rural Staffing Services talent network. You may be considered for current or upcoming case management, social work, utilization review, discharge planning, and care coordination opportunities that align with your experience, goals, preferred location, and availability.

Please submit your resume and let us know:

  • Which Wyoming communities or regions you would consider
  • Whether you are open to relocation
  • Whether you are interested in permanent, interim, remote, or multiple types of opportunities
  • Which position or community you were viewing on RSSJobs.org

Our team personally reviews each application. When we identify an opportunity that may be a strong match, we will contact you directly to share more about the organization, community, position, and next steps.

Your information will be handled professionally and confidentially.

Discover More Rural Healthcare Opportunities

Visit to explore additional rural healthcare positions, leadership opportunities, and communities throughout Wyoming.

Work Where It Matters.

Built for Rural.

jobs.description:
What We Do

We’re on a mission to empower animal healthcare professionals with opportunities to earn more and achieve greater flexibility in their careers and personal lives.

Powered by groundbreaking technology, Roo has built the industry-leading veterinary staffing platform, connecting Veterinarians, Technicians, and Assistants with animal hospitals for relief work and hiring opportunities. Roo empowers the largest network of over 20,000 veterinary professionals to help more than 9,000 animal hospitals provide quality care to more pets.
Together, we’ve provided more than 3 million hours of healthcare, helping Veterinarians earn more than $200 million.

About the Role

We're in the builder era. Prompt-to-feature workflows are real, AI coding tools are the new norm, and the teams that win will be the ones who set up the right infrastructure to move fast with them.

We're hiring an engineer to own the frontend platform at Roo. That includes our design system, shared UI architecture, developer tooling, AI-assisted workflows, and the technical foundation that helps every team member build polished, consistent product experiences.

You're creating the workflows that unlock capacity for the whole team. You'll identify and build the highest-leverage improvements to our frontend platform, from design system tooling and AI integrations to shared infrastructure, developer experience, and platform modernization. Your customers are every builder at Roo—engineers, designers, and AI agents. Success in this role means making it dramatically easier for all of them to build great product experiences.

This is a high-agency, find-it-fix-it-ship-it role. You'll identify the problems, scope the solutions, and build them, without needing a full squad behind you. The right person is already using AI tools to move faster than anyone around them and sees this as a chance to do that at platform scale.

Responsibilities

  • Own the long-term technical direction of Roo's frontend platform, including the systems, tooling, and architecture that power development across web and mobile.
  • Partner with Product and Design to evolve our design system as a foundational platform rather than a standalone library.
  • Make our design system effortless to consume by engineers, designers, and AI agents through thoughtful integrations, documentation, tooling, and developer workflows.
  • Lead platform initiatives like framework upgrades, React Native modernization, Expo adoption, and shared library evolution.
  • Own the migration of legacy components to our v2 design system — including the tooling and documentation that let the rest of the team complete the migration themselves.
  • Establish patterns that let engineers ship new pages and flows quickly from a component library that's built for how people actually build in 2026.
  • Improve developer experience through shared tooling, automation, documentation, templates, and workflows that increase engineering velocity.
  • Identify and eliminate the friction points that slow builders down — missing tokens, undocumented patterns, inconsistencies that force one-off decisions — and fix them systematically.

Qualifications

  • Significant experience building production software, including a focus on frontend systems
  • Strong full-stack engineering fundamentals with deep expertise in React and TypeScript. You're equally comfortable building frontend experiences, backend services, developer tooling, and platform infrastructure when the problem calls for it.
  • React Native or mobile experience.
  • Experience working closely with designers and modern design systems. You're comfortable working in Figma and understand how design decisions translate into scalable frontend architecture.
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development: Cursor, Claude, or similar. You're already building meaningfully faster with these tools, and you think about how to extend that leverage to everyone around you.
  • You've connected design systems to prototyping tools, AI coding environments, or engineering pipelines — and you understand what makes those integrations actually get adopted vs. ignored.
  • You operate well in an eng org — you understand how to get work prioritized, you don't need a PM to run interference, and you're comfortable owning a technical roadmap.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Storybook, style-dictionary, or design token pipelines.
  • Experience with animation and interaction frameworks (Framer Motion, Rive, Lottie).

This Role Probably Isn't for You If...

  • You want someone to hand you a scoped project. This role requires finding the problems, not just solving them.
  • You're not actively using AI tools in your workflow. This role is explicitly about building for the AI-assisted era — we need someone already living in it.
  • You need a lot of structure to ship. We move fast, and you'll drive your own roadmap.
  • You want to stay inside the system. The best version of this role is visible, collaborative, and felt across every team building on top of it.

While we are a remote first company, if you are based in San Francisco this will be a hybrid role.

Please see below for compensation ranges based on our geographical tiering system recommended by external benchmark data (with example cities listed).

Note: We’ve recently been made aware of a job scam where scammers are posing as Roo employees and conducting fake text interviews. Please note that any communication from @lifeatroo.com is not legitimate. All official Roo communication will always come from @roo.vet.

Core Values

Our Core Values are what shape us as an organization and we're looking for people who exhibit the same values in their professional life; Bias to Urgency, Drive Measurable Impact, Seek Understanding, Solve Customer Problems and Have Fun!

What to expect from working at Roo!

For permanent, full time employees, we offer:
  • Accelerated growth & learning potential.

Overall, you would be part of a mission-driven company that will significantly empower the lives of all veterinary professionals and the health of the overall animal industry that seeks massive innovation.
We have diverse, passionate & driven team members from a variety of backgrounds, and Roo is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates. This leader will be accountable for translating national strategy into regional execution, driving business performance through strong field leadership, cross-functional partnership, and disciplined execution against launch objectives.

The RSD will build and lead a high-performing team of territory managers, foster deep customer relationships, and ensure alignment with corporate priorities, compliance standards, and Mineralys’ values.   • Albany, NY
  • Poughkeepsie, NY
  • Hartford, CT
  • Waterbury, CT
  • Providence, RI
  • Worcester, MA

  • Boston, MA

  • Translate national brand strategy into actionable regional business plans and field execution priorities
  • Lead team to achieve or exceed sales goals, market share targets, and key performance metrics at launch and beyond

  • Drive accountability for performance through data-driven decision making and disciplined execution

Compliance / Operational Excellence

jobs.description:
It’s More Than a Career, It’s a Mission.

Our people are the foundation of our success. By joining our growing team at Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI), a subsidiary of McKesson, you will have the opportunity to become part of one of the largest community-based cancer programs to advance oncology treatments and improve outcomes for cancer patients across the globe. We look for mission-driven candidates who have a desire to advance the fight against cancer and make a difference in the lives of patients diagnosed with cancer every day.

Our Mission

People who live with cancer – those who work to prevent it, fight it, and survive it – are at the heart of every decision we make. Bringing the most innovative medical minds together with the most passionate caregivers in their communities, we are transforming care and personalizing treatment. Through clinical excellence and cutting-edge research, SCRI is redefining cancer care around the world.

The AVP of Digital Transformation will spearhead the enterprise-wide integration of digital technologies at SCRI. This role demands a visionary leader who can seamlessly align technology strategy with business priorities, ignite innovation, and deliver measurable impact through digital excellence.

Success in this role requires a deep command of emerging technologies—particularly AI—and the business acumen to translate them into scalable, value-driven solutions. This leader will architect and execute strategic plans that not only implement technology but also drive adoption and maximize enterprise value.

While deeply embedded within specific business segments to ensure contextual relevance, this leader maintains a clear enterprise-wide perspective—balancing local needs with global outcomes to deliver transformative results across SCRI.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Planning & Alignment Partner with senior executives and research leaders to embed digital technologies, data analytics, and AI into clinical research operations—ensuring alignment with SCRI’s overarching business and research strategies.

  • Data & AI Vision Execution Define a forward-looking strategy for data and AI integration in clinical research. Champion the deployment of AI-driven tools to transform cancer care

  • Product Management Leadership Lead the full product lifecycle for digital solutions—from ideation and roadmap development to stakeholder alignment and continuous improvement. Lead product teams to prioritize features and initiatives based on their potential benefit and business objectives. Ensure initiatives are delivered on time, within scope, and with measurable business impact.

  • Use Case Development & ROI Articulation Identify high-impact use cases for digital transformation and AI across clinical operations. Conduct rigorous ROI analyses to build stakeholder confidence and secure investment.

  • AI-Driven Process Optimization Leverage AI and machine learning to analyze and streamline business processes, improve data integrity, and elevate the patient experience.

  • Change Management & Adoption Leadership Lead enterprise-wide change initiatives to drive adoption of new technologies. Partner with change management teams to deliver training, communication, and support strategies that ensure sustained value realization.

  • Risk & Compliance Oversight Provide strategic guidance on the risks and benefits of digital and AI technologies in clinical research. Ensure all initiatives comply with quality standards and ethical frameworks.

  • Performance Measurement & Reporting Establish and track KPIs to evaluate the impact of digital and AI initiatives on research productivity, quality, and operational efficiency.

  • Team Leadership & Talent Development Build and lead a high-performing digital transformation team. Mentor and coach team members to grow capabilities, foster innovation, and cultivate a culture of continuous learning and excellence.

  • Stakeholder Engagement & Ecosystem Collaboration Build and nurture strong relationships with internal stakeholders, technology vendors, regulatory bodies, and clinical partners to foster innovation and cross-functional alignment.

Key Competencies:

  • Digital Clinical Research Tools and Technologies

  • Data Analytics and AI

  • Innovation and Change Advocacy

  • Strategic Thinking and Problem Solving

  • Effective Communication and Stakeholder Management

  • Data-Driven Decision Making

  • Regulatory Knowledge and Compliance

  • Leadership and Team Development

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor's Degree

  • Typically, 15+ years of experience in clinical research or a related field, with a strong focus on digital transformation, data analytics, and AI integration.

  • Demonstrated experience in leading digital and AI initiatives within a clinical or healthcare setting.

  • Proven track record in strategic planning, project management, and change leadership.

  • In-depth understanding of clinical research processes, regulatory requirements, and industry trends.

  • Access to cutting-edge technology and tools to support digital strategy.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize tasks effectively.

  • Collaborate in a dynamic, fast-paced setting with a team of skilled professionals.

  • Opportunity to influence and drive innovation within the organization.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to address complex challenges.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and inspire across all levels of the organization.

  • Proficiency in system design tools and methodologies

  • Experience with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud for scalable and secure data storage and processing

  • Experience with ensuring interoperability between different clinical systems and platforms to facilitate seamless data exchange and collaboration

  • Extensive knowledge of advanced engineering principles, theories, and concepts.

About Sarah Cannon Research Institute

Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI) is one of the world’s leading oncology research organizations conducting community-based clinical trials. Focused on advancing therapies for patients over the last three decades, SCRI is a leader in drug development. In 2022, SCRI formed a joint venture with former US Oncology Research to expand clinical trial access across the country. It has conducted more than 850 first-in-human clinical trials since its inception and contributed to pivotal research that has led to the majority of new cancer therapies approved by the FDA in the past decade. SCRI’s research network brings together more than 1,300 physicians who are enrolling patients into clinical trials at more than 200 locations in 20+ states across the U.S. Please click here to learn more about our research offerings.

jobs.description:
Wyoming Rural Healthcare IT and HIM Leadership Opportunities

Rural Staffing Services partners with rural hospitals, clinics, public hospital districts, and community healthcare organizations throughout Wyoming to identify experienced information technology and health information leaders who understand the unique needs of rural healthcare.

We are currently connecting with professionals who may be interested in active and upcoming IT, information systems, health information management, medical records, clinical informatics, and data leadership opportunities across Wyoming.

These opportunities may include leadership within Critical Access Hospitals, Rural Health Clinics, Federally Qualified Health Centers, public hospital districts, community hospitals, long-term care organizations, and integrated rural healthcare systems.

Explore Rural Healthcare Opportunities at RSSJobs.org

This application may connect you with the specific opportunity you were viewing, as well as other current or upcoming rural healthcare positions throughout Wyoming that align with your experience and goals.

Visit to explore additional rural healthcare opportunities and communities.

This Is More Than an IT or HIM Role

Technology and health information are central to nearly every part of modern healthcare.

In a rural organization, IT and HIM leaders help ensure employees have dependable systems, patient information is protected, records are accurate, and technology supports safe, efficient care.

These leaders may oversee everything from infrastructure, cybersecurity, EHR systems, and technical support to medical records, privacy, coding oversight, data integrity, and information governance.

The strongest rural IT and HIM leaders understand that technology is not simply about systems. It is about people, communication, trust, and making sure staff have the tools and information they need to serve their community.

Opportunities May Include

This application may connect you with current or upcoming roles such as:

  • Chief Information Officer
  • Information Technology Director or Manager
  • Information Systems Director or Manager
  • Health Information Management Director or Manager
  • Medical Records Director or Manager
  • Clinical Informatics Director or Manager
  • EHR or Applications Manager
  • Network or Infrastructure Manager
  • Cybersecurity Leadership
  • Privacy Officer
  • Data Governance or Analytics Leadership
  • Systems Administrator Leadership
  • IT Project or Implementation Manager
  • Senior IT, HIM, informatics, or records supervisory roles

What You May Lead

Responsibilities will vary by organization and position and may include:

  • Providing strategic and operational leadership for IT, HIM, or information systems
  • Supporting reliable technology, infrastructure, networks, devices, and applications
  • Leading EHR optimization, implementation, upgrades, and user support
  • Strengthening cybersecurity, access controls, backup, recovery, and business continuity
  • Protecting patient information and supporting HIPAA compliance
  • Overseeing medical records, document integrity, release of information, and retention
  • Supporting accurate data, reporting, analytics, and information governance
  • Managing vendors, contracts, budgets, projects, and technology planning
  • Leading help desk, systems administration, applications, or technical support teams
  • Developing policies, procedures, and internal controls
  • Supporting privacy, security, audit, and regulatory readiness
  • Collaborating with clinical, operational, finance, revenue cycle, and executive leaders
  • Training employees and helping teams adopt new systems and workflows
  • Improving the connection between technology, information, and patient care
  • Helping the organization prepare for growth, modernization, or system transition

What You Will Bring

Qualifications will vary by opportunity, but organizations may seek:

  • Progressive experience in healthcare IT, information systems, HIM, medical records, clinical informatics, privacy, cybersecurity, or data management
  • Previous leadership experience as a director, manager, supervisor, CIO, or comparable professional
  • Experience with healthcare systems, EHR platforms, networks, data, privacy, or records management
  • Knowledge of HIPAA, information security, health information regulations, or documentation standards
  • Experience managing projects, vendors, budgets, implementations, or system upgrades
  • Strong communication, problem-solving, and team-development skills
  • Experience working with clinical, operational, and executive leaders
  • Rural hospital, Critical Access Hospital, FQHC, public hospital district, long-term care, or community healthcare experience
  • Relevant education, certification, or technical credentials based on the position
  • A practical, collaborative, and service-focused leadership style

Some opportunities may prefer credentials such as RHIA, RHIT, CHPS, CPHIMS, CISSP, PMP, or other healthcare information, privacy, security, or technology certifications. Requirements will depend on the specific role.

Why Rural Wyoming?

Wyoming's rural healthcare organizations serve communities surrounded by mountains, high plains, ranchlands, rivers, open roads, and wide-open spaces. These organizations may operate with smaller teams and limited resources while depending on technology and accurate information every day.

IT and HIM leadership in a rural setting offers the opportunity to modernize systems, support employees, protect patient information, and strengthen care across an entire organization.

Join the RSS Rural Talent Network

By applying through this page, you are joining the confidential Rural Staffing Services talent network. You may be considered for current or upcoming IT and HIM leadership opportunities that align with your experience, goals, preferred location, and availability.

Please submit your resume and let us know:

  • Which Wyoming communities or regions you would consider
  • Whether you are open to relocation
  • Whether you are interested in permanent, interim, remote, or multiple types of opportunities
  • Which position or community you were viewing on RSSJobs.org

Our team personally reviews each application. When we identify an opportunity that may be a strong match, we will contact you directly to share more about the organization, community, technology or information needs, and next steps.

Your information will be handled professionally and confidentially.

Discover More Rural Healthcare Opportunities

Visit to explore additional rural healthcare positions, leadership opportunities, and communities throughout Wyoming.

Work Where It Matters.

Built for Rural.
